def_en: To succeed in doing or completing something
def_zh: 完成 wánchéng；实现 shíxiàn
quote_en: I felt proud when I finally accomplished my science project after working on it for two weeks.
quote_zh: 当我花了两周时间终于完成科学作业时，我感到非常自豪。 Dāng wǒ huāle liǎng zhōu shíjiān zhōngyú wánchéng kēxué zuòyè shí, wǒ gǎndào fēicháng zìháo.
ex_en: Every big dream starts with small steps—when you accomplish one goal, you prove to yourself that you can reach the next one too.
ex_zh: 每一个伟大的梦想都始于小小的步伐——当你完成一个目标时，你就是在向自己证明，下一个目标你也能够实现。 Měi yī gè wěidà de mèngxiǎng dōu shǐ yú xiǎoxiǎo de bùfá——dāng nǐ wánchéng yī gè mùbiāo shí, nǐ jiùshì zài xiàng zìjǐ zhèngmíng, xià yī gè mùbiāo nǐ yě nénggòu shíxiàn.

def_en: A mixture or joining of two or more things
def_zh: 结合 jiéhé；组合 zǔhé；混合 hùnhé
quote_en: The perfect combination of teamwork and practice helped our class win the relay race.
quote_zh: 团队合作与练习的完美结合帮助我们班赢得了接力赛。 Tuánduì hézuò yǔ liànxí de wánměi jiéhé bāngzhù wǒmen bān yíngdé le jiēlì sài.
ex_en: Life is a beautiful combination of effort and patience—give both your best, and wonderful things will grow.
ex_zh: 生活是努力与耐心的美好结合——把两者都做到最好，美好的事物就会生长出来。 Shēnghuó shì nǔlì yǔ nàixīn de měihǎo jiéhé——bǎ liǎngzhě dōu zuò dào zuìhǎo, měihǎo de shìwù jiù huì shēngzhǎng chūlái.

def_en: Extremely important or necessary
def_zh: 至关重要的 zhìguān zhòngyào de；关键性的 guānjiàn xìng de
quote_en: Remembering to bring my homework was crucial because the teacher said it counted toward our final grade.
quote_zh: 记得带上作业至关重要，因为老师说这会计入期末成绩。 Jìdé dàishàng zuòyè zhìguān zhòngyào, yīnwèi lǎoshī shuō zhè huì jìrù qīmò chéngjì.
ex_en: Small choices you make every day—like being kind or working hard—are crucial steps on the path to becoming the person you want to be.
ex_zh: 你每天做出的微小选择——比如善待他人或努力学习——都是通往你想成为的那个人的关键步伐。 Nǐ měitiān zuòchū de wēixiǎo xuǎnzé——bǐrú shàndài tārén huò nǔlì xuéxí——dōu shì tōngwǎng nǐ xiǎng chéngwéi de nàgè rén de guānjiàn bùfá.

def_en: To make an exact copy of something
def_zh: 复制 fùzhì；复印 fùyìn
quote_en: I used the school printer to duplicate my drawing so I could give one copy to my grandma and keep one for myself.
quote_zh: 我用学校的打印机复制了我的画，这样我就可以送给奶奶一张，自己留一张。 Wǒ yòng xuéxiào de dǎyìnjī fùzhìle wǒ de huà, zhèyàng wǒ jiù kěyǐ sòng gěi nǎinai yī zhāng, zìjǐ liú yī zhāng.
ex_en: You don't need to duplicate someone else's success—your own unique path will lead you to achievements that no one else can copy.
ex_zh: 你不需要复制别人的成功——属于你自己的独特道路，会带你抵达别人无法复制的成就。 Nǐ bù xūyào fùzhì biérén de chénggōng——shǔyú nǐ zìjǐ de dútè dàolù, huì dài nǐ dǐdá biérén wúfǎ fùzhì de chéngjiù.

def_en: To come out or appear from a hidden place
def_zh: 出现 chūxiàn；浮现 fúxiàn；显露 xiǎnlù
quote_en: The shy boy slowly began to emerge as a confident leader during our group projects.
quote_zh: 那个害羞的男孩在小组活动中慢慢展现出自信的领导者风范。 Nàgè hàixiū de nánhái zài xiǎozǔ huódòng zhōng mànmàn zhǎnxiàn chū zìxìn de lǐngdǎozhě fēngfàn.
ex_en: Just like a butterfly must emerge from its cocoon, your greatest strengths often emerge when you face challenges with courage.
ex_zh: 就像蝴蝶必须破茧而出一样，你最强大的力量往往在你勇敢面对挑战时才会展现出来。 Jiù xiàng húdié bìxū pò jiǎn ér chū yīyàng, nǐ zuì qiángdà de lìliang wǎngwǎng zài nǐ yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn shí cái huì zhǎnxiàn chūlái.

def_en: Not relying on others; able to do things for yourself
def_zh: 独立的 dúlì de；自立的 zìlì de
quote_en: I became more independent when I started walking to school by myself this year.
quote_zh: 今年我开始自己走路去上学，变得更独立了。 Jīnnián wǒ kāishǐ zìjǐ zǒulù qù shàngxué, biàn dé gèng dúlì le.
ex_en: Being independent doesn't mean doing everything alone—it means knowing when to trust yourself and when to ask for help.
ex_zh: 独立并不意味着凡事都独自完成——它意味着懂得何时相信自己，何时寻求帮助。 Dúlì bìng bù yìwèizhe fánshì dōu dúzì wánchéng——tā yìwèizhe dǒngdé héshí xiāngxìn zìjǐ, héshí xúnqiú bāngzhù.

def_en: To succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem
def_zh: 克服 kèfú；战胜 zhànshèng
quote_en: With help from my friends, I was able to overcome my fear of speaking in front of the class.
quote_zh: 在朋友们的帮助下，我克服了在全班同学面前发言的恐惧。 Zài péngyoumen de bāngzhù xià, wǒ kèfúle zài quánbān tóngxué miànqián fāyán de kǒngjù.
ex_en: Every time you overcome a challenge, you grow a little stronger—like a tree that stands firm after a storm.
ex_zh: 每当你克服一个挑战，你都会变得更强壮一些——就像暴风雨后依然挺立的大树。 Měi dāng nǐ kèfú yī gè tiǎozhàn, nǐ dōu huì biàn dé gèng qiángzhuàng yīxiē——jiù xiàng bàofēngyǔ hòu yīrán tǐnglì de dàshù.

def_en: Strange or unusual
def_zh: 奇怪的 qíguài de；异常的 yìcháng de；独特的 dútè de
quote_en: My dog has a peculiar habit of chasing his own tail whenever he gets excited.
quote_zh: 我的狗有一个奇怪的习惯，一兴奋就会追着自己的尾巴跑。 Wǒ de gǒu yǒu yī gè qíguài de xíguàn, yī xīngfèn jiù huì zhuīzhe zìjǐ de wěiba pǎo.
ex_en: What makes you peculiar is what makes you special—embrace the things that set you apart from everyone else.
ex_zh: 让你显得独特的地方，正是让你与众不同的地方——拥抱那些让你脱颖而出的特质。 Ràng nǐ xiǎndé dútè de dìfāng, zhèngshì ràng nǐ yǔ zhòng bùtóng de dìfāng——yōngbào nàxiē ràng nǐ tuōyǐng ér chū de tèzhì.

def_en: To confuse or puzzle someone greatly
def_zh: 使困惑 shǐ kùnhuò；使迷惑 shǐ míhuò
quote_en: The tricky riddle my brother gave me completely perplexed me for almost an hour.
quote_zh: 哥哥给我的那个谜语让我困惑了将近一个小时。 Gēge gěi wǒ de nàgè míyǔ ràng wǒ kùnhuòle jiāngjìn yī gè xiǎoshí.
ex_en: When something perplexes you, don't give up—asking questions is how curious minds grow.
ex_zh: 当遇到让你困惑的事情时，不要放弃——提出问题正是好奇的头脑成长的方式。 Dāng yùdào ràng nǐ kùnhuò de shìqíng shí, bùyào fàngqì——tíchū wèntí zhèngshì hàoqí de tóunǎo chéngzhǎng de fāngshì.

def_en: Small in number or amount; thinly scattered
def_zh: 稀少的 xīshǎo de；稀疏的 xīshū de
quote_en: The attendance was sparse on the rainy day, with only half the class showing up.
quote_zh: 下雨天出勤率很低，只有半个班的学生来了。 Xiàyǔtiān chūqín lǜ hěn dī, zhǐyǒu bàn gè bān de xuéshēng láile.
ex_en: A forest starts with sparse seeds—but with time and care, it becomes a place of abundance.
ex_zh: 森林始于稀疏的种子——但经过时间的浇灌和精心的呵护，它会变成一片丰茂之地。 Sēnlín shǐ yú xīshū de zhǒngzi——dàn jīngguò shíjiān de jiāoguàn hé jīngxīn de hēhù, tā huì biànchéng yī piàn fēngmào zhī dì.

def_en: To signal or call someone with a gesture
def_zh: 招手示意 zhāoshǒu shìyì；召唤 zhàohuàn
quote_en: My friend beckoned me to come sit next to her when she saved me a seat in the cafeteria.
quote_zh: 我的朋友在食堂帮我留了座位，招手叫我过去坐。 Wǒ de péngyou zài shítáng bāng wǒ liúle zuòwèi, zhāoshǒu jiào wǒ guòqù zuò.
ex_en: Opportunities often beckon quietly—pay attention, and be brave enough to step forward when they call.
ex_zh: 机会常常悄无声息地招手——用心留意，当它们呼唤时，要勇敢地走上前去。 Jīhuì chángcháng qiǎo wú shēng xī de zhāoshǒu——yòng xīn liúyì, dāng tāmen hūhuàn shí, yào yǒnggǎn de zǒu shàng qián qù.

def_en: To give something as an honor or gift
def_zh: 授予 shòuyǔ；赠予 zèngyǔ
quote_en: The principal will bestow the Good Citizen award to the student who helped the elderly neighbor.
quote_zh: 校长将把好公民奖授予那位帮助了年迈邻居的学生。 Xiàozhǎng jiāng bǎ hǎo gōngmín jiǎng shòuyǔ nà wèi bāngzhùle niánmài línjū de xuéshēng.
ex_en: The greatest gift you can bestow upon others is your kindness—it costs nothing but means everything.
ex_zh: 你能给予他人的最珍贵的礼物就是你的善意——它无需分文，却意义非凡。 Nǐ néng jǐyǔ tārén de zuì zhēnguì de lǐwù jiùshì nǐ de shànyì——tā wúxū fēnwén, què yìyì fēifán.

def_en: A difficult task or problem that tests someone's abilities
def_zh: 挑战 tiǎozhàn；难题 nántí
quote_en: Learning to play the recorder was a challenge at first, but I kept practicing every day.
quote_zh: 一开始学吹竖笛是个挑战，但我每天都坚持练习。 Yī kāishǐ xué chuī shùdí shì gè tiǎozhàn, dàn wǒ měitiān dōu jiānchí liànxí.
ex_en: A challenge is not a wall to stop you—it's a mountain that shows you how strong you can become.
ex_zh: 挑战不是阻挡你的高墙，而是一座山峰，让你看见自己能变得多么强大。 Tiǎozhàn bùshì zǔdǎng nǐ de gāoqiáng, ér shì yī zuò shānfēng, ràng nǐ kànjiàn zìjǐ néng biàn dé duōme qiángdà.

def_en: To become smaller or less
def_zh: 减少 jiǎnshǎo；降低 jiàngdī
quote_en: The number of mistakes in my spelling test decreased after I started reviewing my words each night.
quote_zh: 自从我开始每晚复习单词后，拼写测试中的错误减少了。 Zìcóng wǒ kāishǐ měi wǎn fùxí dāncí hòu, pīnxiě cèshì zhōng de cuòwù jiǎnshǎole.
ex_en: Worries decrease when you share them with someone who cares—a problem shared is a problem halved.
ex_zh: 当你与关心你的人分享烦恼时，烦恼就会减少——一份烦恼与人分担，就只剩下一半了。 Dāng nǐ yǔ guānxīn nǐ de rén fēnxiǎng fánnǎo shí, fánnǎo jiù huì jiǎnshǎo——yī fèn fánnǎo yǔ rén fēndān, jiù zhǐ shèngxià yībàn le.

def_en: Absolutely necessary; extremely important
def_zh: 必不可少的 bìbùkěshǎo de；非常重要的 fēicháng zhòngyào de
quote_en: Water and healthy food are essential for staying strong and focused during the school day.
quote_zh: 水和健康的食物对于在上学期间保持精力充沛和注意力集中至关重要。 Shuǐ hé jiànkāng de shíwù duìyú zài shàngxué qījiān bǎochí jīnglì chōngpèi hé zhùyìlì jízhōng zhìguān zhòngyào.
ex_en: Practice is essential for growth—every master was once a beginner who refused to give up.
ex_zh: 练习对于成长至关重要——每一位大师都曾是拒绝放弃的初学者。 Liànxí duìyú chéngzhǎng zhìguān zhòngyào——měi yī wèi dàshī dōu céng shì jùjué fàngqì de chūxuézhě.

def_en: Extremely large; huge
def_zh: 巨大的 jùdà de；庞大的 pángdà de
quote_en: The gigantic oak tree in our schoolyard provides shade for everyone during summer sports.
quote_zh: 我们校园里那棵巨大的橡树在夏天运动时为大家提供了阴凉。 Wǒmen xiàoyuán lǐ nà kē jùdà de xiàngshù zài xiàtiān yùndòng shí wèi dàjiā tígōngle yīnliáng.
ex_en: Even the most gigantic achievements start with one small, brave step forward.
ex_zh: 即使是最巨大的成就，也始于一个微小而勇敢的前行。 Jíshǐ shì zuì jùdà de chéngjiù, yě shǐ yú yī gè wēixiǎo ér yǒnggǎn de qiánxíng.

def_en: With close attention; in a focused way
def_zh: 专心地 zhuānxīn de；专注地 zhuānzhù de
quote_en: The whole class listened intently as the author read an excerpt from her new book.
quote_zh: 全班同学都专心地听着那位作家朗读她新书中的选段。 Quánbān tóngxué dōu zhuānxīn de tīngzhe nà wèi zuòjiā lǎngdú tā xīnshū zhōng de xuǎnduàn.
ex_en: When you listen intently, you show respect—and you often learn something you would have otherwise missed.
ex_zh: 当你专注地倾听时，你既表达了尊重，也常常能学到原本会错过的宝贵知识。 Dāng nǐ zhuānzhù de qīngtīng shí, nǐ jì biǎodále zūnzhòng, yě chángcháng néng xué dào yuánběn huì cuòguò de bǎoguì zhīshi.

def_en: Not thinking too highly of oneself; humble or not large in size
def_zh: 谦虚的 qiānxū de；适度的 shìdù de；朴素的 pǔsù de
quote_en: Even though she won the spelling bee, she remained modest and congratulated the other competitors.
quote_zh: 尽管她赢得了拼写比赛，她依然保持谦虚，并向其他参赛者表示祝贺。 Jǐnguǎn tā yíngdéle pīnxiě bǐsài, tā yīrán bǎochí qiānxū, bìng xiàng qítā cānsài zhě biǎoshì zhùhè.
ex_en: A modest heart leaves room to grow—there is always something new to learn from others.
ex_zh: 谦虚的心为成长留出了空间——从他人身上总有新东西值得学习。 Qiānxū de xīn wèi chéngzhǎng liú chūle kōngjiān——cóng tārén shēnshàng zǒng yǒu xīn dōngxi zhídé xuéxí.

def_en: To look like or be similar to someone or something
def_zh: 像 xiàng；与…相似 yǔ…xiāngsì
quote_en: Many people say I resemble my dad because we both have curly hair and a big smile.
quote_zh: 很多人都说我长得像爸爸，因为我们都有卷卷的头发和灿烂的笑容。 Hěnduō rén dōu shuō wǒ zhǎng de xiàng bàba, yīnwèi wǒmen dōu yǒu juǎnjuǎn de tóufa hé cànlàn de xiàoróng.
ex_en: You don't need to resemble anyone else to be wonderful—being yourself is more than enough.
ex_zh: 你不需要像其他任何人才能变得优秀——做你自己就已经足够美好。 Nǐ bù xūyào xiàng qítā rènhé rén cáinéng biàn dé yōuxiù——zuò nǐ zìjǐ jiù yǐjīng zúgòu měihǎo.

def_en: Serious and dignified; not cheerful or playful
def_zh: 严肃的 yánsù de；庄重的 zhuāngzhòng de
quote_en: The class grew solemn when we learned that our beloved janitor was retiring after 30 years.
quote_zh: 当我们得知敬爱的校工工作了三十年后要退休时，全班都变得严肃起来。 Dāng wǒmen dézhī jìng'ài de xiàogōng gōngzuòle sānshí nián hòu yào tuìxiū shí, quánbān dōu biàn dé yánsù qǐlái.
ex_en: There is strength in solemn moments—they remind us to be grateful for what truly matters.
ex_zh: 庄严的时刻蕴含着力量——它们提醒我们珍惜真正重要的人和事。 Zhuāngyán de shíkè yùnhánzhe lìliang——tāmen tíxǐng wǒmen zhēnxī zhēnzhèng zhòngyào de rén hé shì.

def_en: Correct and exact; with no mistakes
def_zh: 准确的 zhǔnquè de；精确的 jīngquè de
quote_en: My prediction about the soccer game winner was accurate—our team scored in the last minute.
quote_zh: 我对足球比赛获胜者的预测很准确——我们队在最后一分钟进球了。 Wǒ duì zúqiú bǐsài huòshèng zhě de yùcè hěn zhǔnquè——wǒmen duì zài zuìhòu yī fēnzhōng jìnqiú le.
ex_en: Being accurate matters, but so does trying—mistakes are simply steps toward getting it right.
ex_zh: 做到准确很重要，但勇于尝试同样重要——错误只是通向正确的阶梯。 Zuò dào zhǔnquè hěn zhòngyào, dàn yǒngyú chángshì tóngyàng zhòngyào——cuòwù zhǐshì tōngxiàng zhèngquè de jiētī.

def_en: The customs, arts, and way of life of a particular group
def_zh: 文化 wénhuà；文明 wénmíng
quote_en: Our school celebrates different cultures by having families share traditional food and stories.
quote_zh: 我们学校通过邀请家庭分享传统食物和故事来庆祝不同的文化。 Wǒmen xuéxiào tōngguò yāoqǐng jiātíng fēnxiǎng chuántǒng shíwù hé gùshì lái qìngzhù bùtóng de wénhuà.
ex_en: Every culture has something beautiful to teach us—curiosity about others makes the world a kinder place.
ex_zh: 每一种文化都有美好的东西可以教给我们——对他人的好奇让世界变得更加友善。 Měi yī zhǒng wénhuà dōu yǒu měihǎo de dōngxi kěyǐ jiāo gěi wǒmen——duì tārén de hàoqí ràng shìjiè biàn dé gèngjiā yǒushàn.

def_en: To take someone's attention away from what they are doing
def_zh: 分散注意力 fēnsàn zhùyìlì；使分心 shǐ fēnxīn
quote_en: The noise from the construction outside tried to distract me, but I focused on finishing my math test.
quote_zh: 外面施工的噪音试图分散我的注意力，但我还是专注于完成数学考试。 Wàimiàn shīgōng de zàoyīn shìtú fēnsàn wǒ de zhùyìlì, dàn wǒ háishì zhuānzhù yú wánchéng shùxué kǎoshì.
ex_en: Don't let small things distract you from your big dreams—keep your eyes on where you want to go.
ex_zh: 不要让琐事分散你对大梦想的注意力——把目光锁定在你想要抵达的地方。 Bùyào ràng suǒshì fēnsàn nǐ duì dà mèngxiǎng de zhùyìlì——bǎ mùguāng suǒdìng zài nǐ xiǎng yào dǐdá de dìfāng.

def_en: Happening often or regularly
def_zh: 频繁的 pínfán de；经常发生的 jīngcháng fāshēng de
quote_en: After frequent practice sessions, I finally learned to ride my bike without training wheels.
quote_zh: 经过频繁的练习，我终于学会了不用辅助轮骑自行车。 Jīngguò pínfán de liànxí, wǒ zhōngyú xuéhuìle bùyòng fǔzhùlún qí zìxíngchē.
ex_en: Frequent effort, even when small, adds up to something remarkable over time.
ex_zh: 频繁的努力，即使每次都很微小，日积月累也会成就非凡。 Pínfán de nǔlì, jíshǐ měi cì dōu hěn wēixiǎo, rì jī yuè lěi yě huì chéngjiù fēifán.

def_en: To pause before doing something because of uncertainty
def_zh: 犹豫 yóuyù；迟疑 chíyí
quote_en: I started to hesitate before raising my hand, but then I remembered that my answer might help the class.
quote_zh: 举手前我有些犹豫，但随后想起自己的答案可能会帮助到全班同学。 Jǔshǒu qián wǒ yǒuxiē yóuyù, dàn suíhòu xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de dá'àn kěnéng huì bāngzhù dào quánbān tóngxué.
ex_en: Don't hesitate to share your ideas—your voice has value, and someone might need to hear it.
ex_zh: 不要犹豫去分享你的想法——你的声音很有价值，也许正有人需要听到它。 Bùyào yóuyù qù fēnxiǎng nǐ de xiǎngfǎ——nǐ de shēngyīn hěn yǒu jiàzhí, yěxǔ zhèng yǒurén xūyào tīng dào tā.

def_en: To make someone extremely angry
def_zh: 激怒 jīnù；使大怒 shǐ dànù
quote_en: It would infuriate me when my little brother borrowed my colored pencils without asking.
quote_zh: 弟弟不问我一声就借走我的彩笔时，总会让我很生气。 Dìdi bù wèn wǒ yī shēng jiù jièzǒu wǒ de cǎibǐ shí, zǒng huì ràng wǒ hěn shēngqì.
ex_en: When something infuriates you, take a deep breath—calm words speak louder than angry shouts.
ex_zh: 当有事情让你愤怒时，深呼吸一下——平静的话语比愤怒的喊叫更有力量。 Dāng yǒu shìqíng ràng nǐ fènnù shí, shēn hūxī yīxià——píngjìng de huàyǔ bǐ fènnù de hǎnjiào gèng yǒu lìliang.

def_en: The number of people living in a place
def_zh: 人口 rénkǒu；人口数量 rénkǒu shùliàng
quote_en: The population of our town has grown so much that we are getting a new school next year.
quote_zh: 我们镇的人口增长了很多，明年要建一所新学校。 Wǒmen zhèn de rénkǒu zēngzhǎngle hěnduō, míngnián yào jiàn yī suǒ xīn xuéxiào.
ex_en: Every person in a population has a unique gift to offer—a community grows stronger when everyone contributes.
ex_zh: 人口中的每一个人都有独特的天赋可以奉献——当每个人都贡献力量时，社区就会变得更强大。 Rénkǒu zhōng de měi yī gèrén dōu yǒu dútè de tiānfù kěyǐ fèngxiàn——dāng měi gèrén dōu gòngxiàn lìliang shí, shèqū jiù huì biàn dé gèng qiángdà.

def_en: Having a sensible and practical view of what is possible
def_zh: 现实的 xiànshí de；切实可行的 qièshí kěxíng de
quote_en: My goal of reading twenty books this year is realistic because I read one book every two weeks.
quote_zh: 我今年读二十本书的目标很现实，因为我每两周就能读完一本。 Wǒ jīnnián dú èrshí běn shū de mùbiāo hěn xiànshí, yīnwèi wǒ měi liǎng zhōu jiù néng dú wán yī běn.
ex_en: Dream big, but set realistic steps along the way—small victories build the path to great success.
ex_zh: 大胆梦想，但沿途设定切实可行的步伐——小小的胜利铺就通往巨大成功的道路。 Dàdǎn mèngxiǎng, dàn yántú shèdìng qièshí kěxíng de bùfá——xiǎoxiǎo de shènglì pū jiù tōngwǎng jùdà chénggōng de dàolù.

def_en: Something that can be used to help achieve a goal
def_zh: 资源 zīyuán；资料 zīliào
quote_en: The school library is my favorite resource for finding interesting books about space and planets.
quote_zh: 学校图书馆是我最喜欢的资源，可以找到关于太空和行星的有趣书籍。 Xuéxiào túshūguǎn shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de zīyuán, kěyǐ zhǎodào guānyú tàikōng hé xíngxīng de yǒuqù shūjí.
ex_en: Your greatest resource is your own curiosity—it will guide you to learn anything you wish to know.
ex_zh: 你最宝贵的资源是你自己的好奇心——它会引导你学会任何你想了解的知识。 Nǐ zuì bǎoguì de zīyuán shì nǐ zìjǐ de hàoqíxīn——tā huì yǐndǎo nǐ xuéhuì rènhé nǐ xiǎng liǎojiě de zhīshi.

def_en: To grow, develop, or succeed strongly
def_zh: 茁壮成长 zhuózhuàng chéngzhǎng；蓬勃发展 péngbó fāzhǎn
quote_en: My tomato plants thrive in the sunny spot by our classroom window.
quote_zh: 我的番茄植物在教室窗边阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。 Wǒ de fānqié zhíwù zài jiàoshì chuāng biān yángguāng chōngzú de dìfāng zhuózhuàng chéngzhǎng.
ex_en: When you surround yourself with encouraging people, you will thrive in ways you never imagined.
ex_zh: 当你身边围绕着鼓励你的人时，你会以从未想象过的方式茁壮成长。 Dāng nǐ shēnbiān wéirào zhe gǔlì nǐ de rén shí, nǐ huì yǐ cóngwèi xiǎngxiàngguò de fāngshì zhuózhuàng chéngzhǎng.

def_en: To tell someone something positively to remove doubt or worry
def_zh: 向…保证 xiàng…bǎozhèng；使确信 shǐ quèxìn
quote_en: My teacher assured me that it was okay to make mistakes because that's how we learn.
quote_zh: 老师向我保证犯错误没关系，因为我们就是这样学习的。 Lǎoshī xiàng wǒ bǎozhèng fàn cuòwù méiguānxì, yīnwèi wǒmen jiùshì zhèyàng xuéxí de.
ex_en: When you assure a friend that they are not alone, you give them a gift stronger than any object.
ex_zh: 当你向朋友保证他们并不孤单时，你送给他们的礼物比任何物品都更珍贵。 Dāng nǐ xiàng péngyou bǎozhèng tāmen bìng bù gūdān shí, nǐ sòng gěi tāmen de lǐwù bǐ rènhé wùpǐn dōu gèng zhēnguì.

def_en: To understand something fully
def_zh: 理解 lǐjiě；领悟 lǐngwù
quote_en: It took me a few tries to comprehend the instructions for the science experiment.
quote_zh: 我试了好几次才理解科学实验的步骤说明。 Wǒ shìle hǎo jǐ cì cái lǐjiě kēxué shíyàn de bùzhòu shuōmíng.
ex_en: To comprehend something new, you must first be brave enough to admit you don't yet know it.
ex_zh: 要理解新的事物，首先要勇敢承认自己还不太明白。 Yào lǐjiě xīn de shìwù, shǒuxiān yào yǒnggǎn chéngrèn zìjǐ hái bù tài míngbái.

def_en: To set up or create something that lasts
def_zh: 建立 jiànlì；设立 shèlì
quote_en: Our class decided to establish a recycling program to help keep our school clean.
quote_zh: 我们班决定建立一个回收计划来帮助保持校园整洁。 Wǒmen bān juédìng jiànlì yī gè huíshōu jìhuà lái bāngzhù bǎochí xiàoyuán zhěngjié.
ex_en: Good habits you establish today will serve you well for the rest of your life.
ex_zh: 你今天建立的好习惯，将为你的一生带来益处。 Nǐ jīntiān jiànlì de hǎo xíguàn, jiāng wèi nǐ de yīshēng dàilái yìchù.

def_en: To describe something as larger or greater than it really is
def_zh: 夸大 kuādà；夸张 kuāzhāng
quote_en: My brother tends to exaggerate when he tells stories about his fishing adventures.
quote_zh: 我哥哥讲钓鱼冒险故事时总喜欢夸张。 Wǒ gēge jiǎng diàoyú màoxiǎn gùshì shí zǒng xǐhuān kuāzhāng.
ex_en: You never need to exaggerate your worth—who you truly are is already enough.
ex_zh: 你永远不需要夸大自己的价值——真实的你，已经足够好。 Nǐ yǒngyuǎn bù xūyào kuādà zìjǐ de jiàzhí——zhēnshí de nǐ, yǐjīng zúgòu hǎo.

def_en: Lacking knowledge or awareness about something
def_zh: 无知的 wúzhī de；不了解的 bù liǎojiě de
quote_en: I was ignorant about how to care for a pet hamster until I read a book about it.
quote_zh: 在读了一本书之前，我对如何照顾宠物仓鼠一无所知。 Zài dúle yī běn shū zhīqián, wǒ duì rúhé zhàogù chǒngwù cāngshǔ yī wú suǒ zhī.
ex_en: Being ignorant isn't a weakness—it's an invitation to learn something new every day.
ex_zh: 无知不是弱点——它是邀请你每天学习新事物的请柬。 Wúzhī bùshì ruòdiǎn——tā shì yāoqǐng nǐ měitiān xuéxí xīn shìwù de qǐngjiǎn.

def_en: Extremely large or great
def_zh: 巨大的 jùdà de；广大的 guǎngdà de
quote_en: The immense whale at the museum exhibit made me feel tiny standing next to it.
quote_zh: 博物馆展览中那头巨大的鲸鱼让我站在旁边时感觉自己很渺小。 Bówùguǎn zhǎnlǎn zhōng nà tóu jùdà de jīngyú ràng wǒ zhàn zài pángbiān shí gǎnjué zìjǐ hěn miǎoxiǎo.
ex_en: You have immense potential within you—sometimes it just takes time and patience to discover it.
ex_zh: 你体内蕴藏着巨大的潜力——有时只是需要时间和耐心去发现它。 Nǐ tǐnèi yùncángzhe jùdà de qiánlì——yǒushí zhǐshì xūyào shíjiān hé nàixīn qù fāxiàn tā.

def_en: A difficult or painful experience
def_zh: 磨难 mónàn；痛苦的经历 tòngkǔ de jīnglì
quote_en: The spelling test felt like an ordeal, but I was relieved when I saw my good grade.
quote_zh: 那次拼写测试感觉像一场磨难，但看到好成绩时我松了一口气。 Nà cì pīnxiě cèshì gǎnjué xiàng yī chǎng mónàn, dàn kàndào hǎo chéngjì shí wǒ sōngle yī kǒuqì.
ex_en: Every ordeal you survive makes you stronger and wiser than you were before.
ex_zh: 你经历的每一次磨难，都会让你比从前更坚强、更睿智。 Nǐ jīnglì de měi yī cì mónàn, dōu huì ràng nǐ bǐ cóngqián gèng jiānqiáng, gèng ruìzhì.

def_en: A careful plan or method for achieving something
def_zh: 策略 cèlüè；方法 fāngfǎ
quote_en: My strategy for the math competition was to solve the easier problems first to build confidence.
quote_zh: 我参加数学竞赛的策略是先解出简单的问题来建立信心。 Wǒ cānjiā shùxué jìngsài de cèlüè shì xiān jiě chū jiǎndān de wèntí lái jiànlì xìnxīn.
ex_en: A good strategy can help you overcome obstacles—but flexibility matters too, because plans can change.
ex_zh: 好的策略能帮你克服困难——但灵活应变同样重要，因为计划总会变化。 Hǎo de cèlüè néng bāng nǐ kèfú kùnnán——dàn línghuó yìngbiàn tóngyàng zhòngyào, yīnwèi jìhuà zǒng huì biànhuà.

def_en: To gather or call forth something, especially courage or strength
def_zh: 鼓起 gǔqǐ；召唤 zhàohuàn；召集 zhàojí
quote_en: I had to summon all my courage to ask the principal if I could start a book club.
quote_zh: 我必须鼓起全部勇气去问校长我是否可以创办一个读书俱乐部。 Wǒ bìxū gǔqǐ quánbù yǒngqì qù wèn xiàozhǎng wǒ shìfǒu kěyǐ chuàngbàn yī gè dúshū jùlèbù.
ex_en: You can always summon strength you didn't know you had—it lives inside you, waiting to be found.
ex_zh: 你总能召唤出自己都未曾意识到的力量——它就住在你心里，等待被发掘。 Nǐ zǒng néng zhàohuàn chū zìjǐ dōu wèicéng yìshí dào de lìliang——tā jiù zhù zài nǐ xīn lǐ, děngdài bèi fājué.

def_en: To tease or mock someone in a cruel way
def_zh: 嘲弄 cháonòng；讥笑 jīxiào
quote_en: The older kids would taunt me for wearing glasses until my friend stood up for me.
quote_zh: 大一点的孩子会因为我戴眼镜而嘲笑我，直到我的朋友站出来替我说话。 Dà yīdiǎn de háizi huì yīnwèi wǒ dài yǎnjìng ér cháoxiào wǒ, zhídào wǒ de péngyou zhàn chūlái tì wǒ shuōhuà.
ex_en: A kind heart does not taunt—it lifts others up, because true strength is gentle.
ex_zh: 善良的心不会嘲弄他人——它会帮助别人站起来，因为真正的力量是温柔的。 Shànliáng de xīn bùhuì cháonòng tārén——tā huì bāngzhù biérén zhàn qǐlái, yīnwèi zhēnzhèng de lìliang shì wēnróu de.

def_en: Something accomplished through effort and skill
def_zh: 成就 chéngjiù；成绩 chéngjì
quote_en: Winning the school science fair was my biggest achievement this year.
quote_zh: 赢得学校科学展览是我今年最大的成就。 Yíngdé xuéxiào kēxué zhǎnlǎn shì wǒ jīnnián zuìdà de chéngjiù.
ex_en: Every achievement, big or small, is proof that effort turns dreams into reality.
ex_zh: 每一项成就，无论大小，都证明了努力能将梦想变为现实。 Měi yī xiàng chéngjiù, wúlùn dàxiǎo, dōu zhèngmíngle nǔlì néng jiāng mèngxiǎng biàn wéi xiànshí.

def_en: To create or write something, such as music or a piece of writing
def_zh: 创作 chuàngzuò；构成 gòuchéng
quote_en: For our music class, we had to compose a short melody using only three notes.
quote_zh: 音乐课上，我们只用三个音符创作了一段短小的旋律。 Yīnyuè kè shàng, wǒmen zhǐ yòng sān gè yīnfú chuàngzuòle yī duàn duǎnxiǎo de xuánlǜ.
ex_en: You compose your own life story every day—make each chapter one you'll be proud to read.
ex_zh: 你每天都在谱写自己的人生故事——让每一个篇章都值得你骄傲地回读。 Nǐ měitiān dōu zài pǔxiě zìjǐ de rénshēng gùshì——ràng měi yī gè piānzhāng dōu zhídé nǐ jiāo'ào de huí dú.

def_en: Very unusual or remarkable
def_zh: 非凡的 fēifán de；特别的 tèbié de
quote_en: The firefighter who rescued the kitten from the tall tree did an extraordinary thing.
quote_zh: 那位消防员从高高的大树上救下小猫，做了一件非凡的事。 Nà wèi xiāofángyuán cóng gāogāo de dàshù shàng jiù xià xiǎomāo, zuòle yī jiàn fēifán de shì.
ex_en: You don't need to be perfect to be extraordinary—you just need to try your best with a kind heart.
ex_zh: 你不需要完美才能变得非凡——你只需要以善良的心全力以赴。 Nǐ bù xūyào wánměi cáinéng biàn dé fēifán——nǐ zhǐ xūyào yǐ shànliáng de xīn quánlì yǐfù.

def_en: To stare with an open mouth in surprise or wonder
def_zh: 目瞪口呆地看 mùdèngkǒudāi de kàn
quote_en: We could only gape in amazement when the magician made a coin disappear right before our eyes.
quote_zh: 当魔术师在我们眼前把一枚硬币变没时，我们都目瞪口呆。 Dāng móshùshī zài wǒmen yǎnqián bǎ yī méi yìngbì biàn méi shí, wǒmen dōu mùdèngkǒudāi.
ex_en: Sometimes life will leave you to gape in wonder—those moments of awe remind you how beautiful the world is.
ex_zh: 有时生活会让你惊叹得目瞪口呆——那些充满敬畏的时刻，提醒你世界有多么美好。 Yǒushí shēnghuó huì ràng nǐ jīngtàn dé mùdèngkǒudāi——nàxiē chōngmǎn jìngwèi de shíkè, tíxǐng nǐ shìjiè yǒu duōme měihǎo.

def_en: Full of joy and delight
def_zh: 欢喜的 huānxǐ de；兴高采烈的 xìnggāocǎiliè de
quote_en: The children were gleeful when they saw the first snowfall of the winter.
quote_zh: 孩子们看到冬天的第一场雪时欣喜若狂。 Háizimen kàndào dōngtiān de dì yī chǎng xuě shí xīnxǐruòkuáng.
ex_en: A gleeful heart makes even ordinary days feel like celebrations—share your joy and watch it multiply.
ex_zh: 欢喜的心让平凡的日子也像庆典——分享你的快乐，看着它成倍增长。 Huānxǐ de xīn ràng píngfán de rìzi yě xiàng qìngdiǎn——fēnxiǎng nǐ de kuàilè, kànzhe tā chéngbèi zēngzhǎng.

def_en: To recognize or name someone or something
def_zh: 识别 shíbié；辨认 biànrèn；确认 quèrèn
quote_en: I can identify different bird species by listening to their songs in the park.
quote_zh: 我可以通过听公园里鸟儿的叫声来辨认不同的种类。 Wǒ kěyǐ tōngguò tīng gōngyuán lǐ niǎo'ér de jiàoshēng lái biànrèn bùtóng de zhǒnglèi.
ex_en: When you can identify what makes you happy, you've found a compass for your life.
ex_zh: 当你能够辨认出让自己快乐的事物时，你就找到了人生的指南针。 Dāng nǐ nénggòu biànrèn chū ràng zìjǐ kuàilè de shìwù shí, nǐ jiù zhǎodàole rénshēng de zhǐnánzhēn.

def_en: To convince someone to do or believe something
def_zh: 说服 shuōfú；劝说 quànshuō
quote_en: I tried to persuade my parents to get a puppy by showing them how responsible I could be.
quote_zh: 我试图说服父母养一只小狗，向他们展示我可以多么负责任。 Wǒ shìtú shuōfú fùmǔ yǎng yī zhī xiǎogǒu, xiàng tāmen zhǎnshì wǒ kěyǐ duōme fùzérèn.
ex_en: The best way to persuade others is not with loud words, but with kind actions that show you care.
ex_zh: 说服他人最好的方式不是响亮的话语，而是用善意的行动表明你的关心。 Shuōfú tārén zuìhǎo de fāngshì bùshì xiǎngliàng de huàyǔ, ér shì yòng shànyì de xíngdòng biǎomíng nǐ de guānxīn.

def_en: To say what will happen in the future
def_zh: 预测 yùcè；预言 yùyán
quote_en: It's hard to predict whether it will rain tomorrow, so I always keep an umbrella in my bag.
quote_zh: 很难预测明天是否会下雨，所以我总是把伞放在书包里。 Hěn nán yùcè míngtiān shìfǒu huì xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ zǒngshì bǎ sǎn fàng zài shūbāo lǐ.
ex_en: You cannot predict every twist in your journey—but you can predict that trying your best will always be worthwhile.
ex_zh: 你无法预测人生旅途中的每一个转折——但你可以预测，全力以赴永远值得。 Nǐ wúfǎ yùcè rénshēng lǚtú zhōng de měi yī gè zhuǎnzhé——dàn nǐ kěyǐ yùcè, quánlì yǐfù yǒngyuǎn zhídé.

def_en: To allow something to happen without complaining; to put up with
def_zh: 容忍 róngrěn；忍受 rěnshòu
quote_en: I can tolerate spicy food much better now than I could at the beginning of the year.
quote_zh: 比起年初，我现在更能吃辣了。 Bǐqǐ niánchū, wǒ xiànzài gèng néng chī là le.
ex_en: Kind people learn to tolerate differences—they know that the world is more beautiful when everyone belongs.
ex_zh: 善良的人学会包容差异——他们明白，当每个人都拥有归属感时，世界才更加美丽。 Shànliáng de rén xuéhuì bāoróng chāyì——tāmen míngbái, dāng měi gèrén dōu yǒngyǒu guīshǔgǎn shí, shìjiè cái gèngjiā měilì.

def_en: Not clear or exact
def_zh: 模糊的 móhú de；不明确的 bù míngquè de
quote_en: The instructions for the art project were vague, so I asked the teacher to explain again.
quote_zh: 美术作业的说明很模糊，所以我请老师再解释一遍。 Měishù zuòyè de shuōmíng hěn móhú, suǒyǐ wǒ qǐng lǎoshī zài jiěshì yī biàn.
ex_en: When your path feels vague, take one small step—clarity often comes as you move forward.
ex_zh: 当你的道路感觉模糊不清时，先迈出一小步——当你向前走时，清晰往往随之而来。 Dāng nǐ de dàolù gǎnjué móhú bù qīng shí, xiān mài chū yī xiǎobù——dāng nǐ xiàng qián zǒu shí, qīngxī wǎngwǎng suí zhī ér lái.

def_en: To say something suddenly without thinking
def_zh: 脱口而出 tuōkǒu ér chū
quote_en: I didn't mean to blurt out the answer, but I was so excited that I knew it.
quote_zh: 我不是故意脱口说出答案的，只是太兴奋了，因为我真的知道。 Wǒ bùshì gùyì tuōkǒu shuō chū dá'àn de, zhǐshì tài xīngfèn le, yīnwèi wǒ zhēnde zhīdào.
ex_en: Before you blurt something out, take one breath—kind words spoken at the right time can make a big difference.
ex_zh: 在你脱口而出之前，先深呼吸一下——在恰当的时机说出的善意话语，能带来很大的不同。 Zài nǐ tuōkǒu ér chū zhīqián, xiān shēn hūxī yīxià——zài qiàdàng de shíjī shuō chū de shànyì huàyǔ, néng dàilái hěndà de bùtóng.

def_en: To point out faults or express disapproval
def_zh: 批评 pīpíng；指责 zhǐzé
quote_en: It's easier to criticize someone's work than to appreciate the effort they put into it.
quote_zh: 批评别人的作品比欣赏他们付出的努力更容易。 Pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn bǐ xīnshǎng tāmen fùchū de nǔlì gèng róngyì.
ex_en: Instead of criticizing, try encouraging—a few kind words can help someone grow more than a hundred complaints.
ex_zh: 与其批评，不如尝试鼓励——几句善意的话语比一百句抱怨更能帮助他人成长。 Yǔqí pīpíng, bùrú chángshì gǔlì——jǐ jù shànyì de huàyǔ bǐ yī bǎi jù bàoyuàn gèng néng bāngzhù tārén chéngzhǎng.

def_en: Weakly made; easily broken or damaged
def_zh: 薄弱的 bóruò de；易损坏的 yì sǔnhuài de
quote_en: My first paper airplane was too flimsy to fly, so I used thicker paper for the next one.
quote_zh: 我做的第一只纸飞机太单薄飞不起来，所以第二只用更厚的纸来做。 Wǒ zuò de dì yī zhǐ zhǐ fēijī tài dānbó fēi bù qǐlái, suǒyǐ dì èr zhǐ yòng gèng hòu de zhǐ lái zuò.
ex_en: A flimsy excuse might get you out of trouble, but honesty builds trust that lasts a lifetime.
ex_zh: 一个站不住脚的借口或许能帮你暂时摆脱麻烦，但诚实能建立持续一生的信任。 Yī gè zhàn bù zhù jiǎo de jièkǒu huòxǔ néng bāng nǐ zànshí bǎituō máfan, dàn chéngshí néng jiànlì chíxù yīshēng de xìnrèn.

def_en: Lucky; having good fortune
def_zh: 幸运的 xìngyùn de
quote_en: I felt fortunate to have such helpful classmates when I was sick and missed a week of school.
quote_zh: 我很幸运有这样乐于助人的同学，在我生病缺课一周时帮助我。 Wǒ hěn xìngyùn yǒu zhèyàng lèyú zhùrén de tóngxué, zài wǒ shēngbìng quēkè yī zhōu shí bāngzhù wǒ.
ex_en: The most fortunate people are not those who have the most, but those who appreciate what they have.
ex_zh: 最幸运的人不是拥有最多的人，而是懂得珍惜已有之物的人。 Zuì xìngyùn de rén bùshì yǒngyǒu zuìduō de rén, ér shì dǒngdé zhēnxī jǐyǒu zhī wù de rén.

def_en: To light up or make something clearer
def_zh: 照亮 zhàoliàng；阐明 chǎnmíng
quote_en: The street lamps illuminate the path so I can walk home safely after dark.
quote_zh: 路灯照亮了道路，让我在天黑后能安全走回家。 Lùdēng zhàoliàngle dàolù, ràng wǒ zài tiān hēi hòu néng ānquán zǒu huí jiā.
ex_en: A good book can illuminate ideas you never thought of before, opening doors in your mind.
ex_zh: 一本好书能照亮你从未想过的想法，为你打开心灵之门。 Yī běn hǎoshū néng zhàoliàng nǐ cóngwèi xiǎngguò de xiǎngfǎ, wèi nǐ dǎkāi xīnlíng zhī mén.

def_en: To plan or mean to do something
def_zh: 打算 dǎsuàn；意图 yìtú
quote_en: I intend to practice the piano every day so I can play a song for my grandmother's birthday.
quote_zh: 我打算每天练习钢琴，这样就能在奶奶生日时为她弹奏一首歌。 Wǒ dǎsuàn měitiān liànxí gāngqín, zhèyàng jiù néng zài nǎinai shēngrì shí wèi tā tánzòu yī shǒu gē.
ex_en: What you intend matters, but what you do matters more—good intentions grow into great actions.
ex_zh: 你的意图很重要，但你的行动更重要——好的意图会成长为伟大的行动。 Nǐ de yìtú hěn zhòngyào, dàn nǐ de xíngdòng gèng zhòngyào——hǎo de yìtú huì chéngzhǎng wéi wěidà de xíngdòng.

def_en: To copy or imitate someone or something
def_zh: 模仿 mófǎng
quote_en: My little sister loves to mimic the way I talk, which can be annoying but also funny.
quote_zh: 我的小妹妹喜欢模仿我说话的样子，虽然有点烦但也很有趣。 Wǒ de xiǎo mèimei xǐhuān mófǎng wǒ shuōhuà de yàngzi, suīrán yǒudiǎn fán dàn yě hěn yǒuqù.
ex_en: Don't just mimic others—find your own voice, because no one else can be you as well as you can.
ex_zh: 不要只是模仿别人——找到你自己的声音，因为没有人能比你做得更好。 Bùyào zhǐshì mófǎng biérén——zhǎodào nǐ zìjǐ de shēngyīn, yīnwèi méiyǒu rén néng bǐ nǐ zuò dé gèng hǎo.

def_en: To mock or make fun of someone in a cruel way
def_zh: 嘲笑 cháoxiào；奚落 xīluò
quote_en: No one should ridicule another person for asking questions—that's how we all learn.
quote_zh: 没有人应该因为别人提问而嘲笑对方——我们都是这样学习的。 Méiyǒu rén yīnggāi yīnwèi biérén tíwèn ér cháoxiào duìfāng——wǒmen dōu shì zhèyàng xuéxí de.
ex_en: Those who ridicule others often hide their own fears—true confidence lifts people up.
ex_zh: 嘲笑他人的人往往是在隐藏自己的恐惧——真正的自信是帮助别人成长。 Cháoxiào tārén de rén wǎngwǎng shì zài yǐncáng zìjǐ de kǒngjù——zhēnzhèng de zìxìn shì bāngzhù biérén chéngzhǎng.

def_en: A distinguishing quality or characteristic
def_zh: 特征 tèzhēng；特点 tèdiǎn
quote_en: One trait I admire in my best friend is her honesty—she always tells me the truth kindly.
quote_zh: 我最欣赏好朋友的一个特质就是她的诚实——她总是善意地告诉我真相。 Wǒ zuì xīnshǎng hǎo péngyou de yī gè tèzhì jiùshì tā de chéngshí——tā zǒngshì shànyì de gàosu wǒ zhēnxiàng.
ex_en: Kindness is a trait that costs nothing to give but becomes priceless to those who receive it.
ex_zh: 善良是一种给予时无需成本、却对接受者而言无比珍贵的品质。 Shànliáng shì yī zhǒng jǐyǔ shí wúxū chéngběn, què duì jiēshòu zhě éryán wúbǐ zhēnguì de pǐnzhì.

def_en: To speak or say something aloud
def_zh: 说出 shuōchū；发声 fāshēng
quote_en: I was so nervous that I couldn't utter a single word during my presentation.
quote_zh: 我太紧张了，演讲时一句话都说不出来。 Wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yǎnjiǎng shí yī jù huà dōu shuō bù chūlái.
ex_en: When you utter words of encouragement, you plant seeds of courage that grow in someone's heart.
ex_zh: 当你说出鼓励的话语时，你就在别人心中种下了勇气的种子。 Dāng nǐ shuōchū gǔlì de huàyǔ shí, nǐ jiù zài biérén xīnzhōng zhòngxiàle yǒngqì de zhǒngzi.

def_en: To change or adapt something slightly
def_zh: 调整 tiáozhěng；适应 shìyìng
quote_en: It took me a few weeks to adjust to wearing glasses, but now I don't even notice them.
quote_zh: 我花了几周时间才适应戴眼镜，但现在我几乎感觉不到它们了。 Wǒ huāle jǐ zhōu shíjiān cái shìyìng dài yǎnjìng, dàn xiànzài wǒ jīhū gǎnjué bù dào tāmen le.
ex_en: Life often asks you to adjust your plans—flexibility helps you find new paths when old ones change.
ex_zh: 生活常常要求你调整计划——灵活应变能帮你在旧路改变时找到新的方向。 Shēnghuó chángcháng yāoqiú nǐ tiáozhěng jìhuà——línghuó yìngbiàn néng bāng nǐ zài jiù lù gǎibiàn shí zhǎodào xīn de fāngxiàng.

def_en: To agree with or allow something officially
def_zh: 同意 tóngyì；批准 pīzhǔn；认可 rènkě
quote_en: My parents approved my idea to raise money for the animal shelter by selling homemade cookies.
quote_zh: 我的父母同意了我通过卖自制饼干为动物收容所筹款的想法。 Wǒ de fùmǔ tóngyìle wǒ tōngguò mài zìzhì bǐnggān wèi dòngwù shōuróngsuǒ chóukuǎn de xiǎngfǎ.
ex_en: The only approval you truly need is your own when you know you've done your best with a kind heart.
ex_zh: 当你用善良的心尽力而为时，你唯一真正需要的认可就是来自你自己。 Dāng nǐ yòng shànliáng de xīn jìnlì ér wéi shí, nǐ wéiyī zhēnzhèng xūyào de rènkě jiùshì láizì nǐ zìjǐ.

def_en: To organize and carry out something
def_zh: 进行 jìnxíng；实施 shíshī；指挥 zhǐhuī
quote_en: Our science class will conduct an experiment to see which plants grow fastest in different lights.
quote_zh: 我们科学课将进行一项实验，观察哪种植物在不同光照下长得最快。 Wǒmen kēxué kè jiāng jìnxíng yī xiàng shíyàn, guānchá nǎ zhǒng zhíwù zài bùtóng guāngzhào xià zhǎng dé zuì kuài.
ex_en: Conduct yourself with kindness and honesty, and you will earn respect that no one can take away.
ex_zh: 以善良和诚实为人处世，你将赢得无人能夺走的尊重。 Yǐ shànliáng hé chéngshí wéirén chǔshì, nǐ jiāng yíngdé wúrén néng duó zǒu de zūnzhòng.

def_en: A disagreement or argument between people
def_zh: 冲突 chōngtū；争执 zhēngzhí
quote_en: My friends had a conflict about which game to play, so we took turns choosing.
quote_zh: 我的朋友们因为玩什么游戏起了争执，于是我们轮流选择。 Wǒ de péngyoumen yīnwèi wán shénme yóuxì qǐle zhēngzhí, yúshì wǒmen lúnliú xuǎnzé.
ex_en: Conflict can be solved when both sides listen—understanding each other is the first step to peace.
ex_zh: 当双方都愿意倾听时，冲突就能解决——互相理解是走向和解的第一步。 Dāng shuāngfāng dōu yuànyì qīngtīng shí, chōngtū jiù néng jiějué——hùxiāng lǐjiě shì zǒuxiàng héjiě de dì yī bù.

def_en: Equal in value, amount, or meaning
def_zh: 相等的 xiāngděng de；等同的 děngtóng de
quote_en: In our math class, we learned that 100 centimeters is equivalent to one meter.
quote_zh: 在数学课上，我们学到了100厘米等于一米。 Zài shùxué kè shàng, wǒmen xué dàole yībǎi límǐ děngyú yī mǐ.
ex_en: Hard work is equivalent to progress—every bit of effort moves you closer to your goal.
ex_zh: 努力等同于进步——每一分付出都让你离目标更近一步。 Nǔlì děngtóng yú jìnbù——měi yī fēn fùchū dōu ràng nǐ lí mùbiāo gèng jìn yī bù.

def_en: Probably going to happen or be true
def_zh: 可能的 kěnéng de；很可能 hěn kěnéng
quote_en: It's likely to rain this afternoon, so I packed my umbrella and raincoat.
quote_zh: 今天下午很可能会下雨，所以我带了雨伞和雨衣。 Jīntiān xiàwǔ hěn kěnéng huì xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dàile yǔsǎn hé yǔyī.
ex_en: You are more likely to succeed when you believe in yourself—confidence opens doors that doubt keeps closed.
ex_zh: 当你相信自己时，你更有可能成功——自信打开门，而怀疑让门紧闭。 Dāng nǐ xiāngxìn zìjǐ shí, nǐ gèng yǒu kěnéng chénggōng——zìxìn dǎkāi mén, ér huáiyí ràng mén jǐnbì.

def_en: To fail to care for or pay attention to something
def_zh: 忽视 hūshì；疏于照顾 shū yú zhàogù
quote_en: I promised myself I wouldn't neglect my homework even when there's a new video game to play.
quote_zh: 我向自己保证，即使有新游戏玩，也不会忽视作业。 Wǒ xiàng zìjǐ bǎozhèng, jíshǐ yǒu xīn yóuxì wán, yě bùhuì hūshì zuòyè.
ex_en: Don't neglect the small acts of kindness—they often mean the most to someone having a hard day.
ex_zh: 不要忽视微小的善意之举——对于正在经历困难的人，它们往往意义非凡。 Bùyào hūshì wēixiǎo de shànyì zhī jǔ——duìyú zhèngzài jīnglì kùnnán de rén, tāmen wǎngwǎng yìyì fēifán.

def_en: Not often; rarely
def_zh: 很少 hěnshǎo；不常 bù cháng
quote_en: I seldom eat junk food because my mom packs healthy snacks in my lunchbox.
quote_zh: 我很少吃垃圾食品，因为妈妈在我的午餐盒里放了健康的零食。 Wǒ hěnshǎo chī lājī shípǐn, yīnwèi māma zài wǒ de wǔcān hé lǐ fàngle jiànkāng de língshí.
ex_en: Words of gratitude are seldom wasted—they cost nothing but can make someone's entire day brighter.
ex_zh: 表达感激的话语从不会白费——它们无需分文，却能照亮别人一整天。 Biǎodá gǎnjī de huàyǔ cóng bùhuì báifèi——tāmen wúxū fēnwén, què néng zhàoliàng biérén yī zhěngtiān.

def_en: Important or large enough to matter
def_zh: 重要的 zhòngyào de；显著的 xiǎnzhù de
quote_en: Getting a library card was a significant moment for me—it meant I could borrow any book I wanted.
quote_zh: 办一张借书证对我来说是一个重要的时刻——这意味着我可以借任何我想看的书。 Bàn yī zhāng jièshūzhèng duì wǒ lái shuō shì yī gè zhòngyào de shíkè——zhè yìwèizhe wǒ kěyǐ jiè rènhé wǒ xiǎng kàn de shū.
ex_en: Even one person can make a significant difference in the world—never underestimate what you can do.
ex_zh: 即使是一个人也能给世界带来重要的改变——永远不要低估自己的能力。 Jíshǐ shì yī gèrén yě néng gěi shìjiè dàilái zhòngyào de gǎibiàn——yǒngyuǎn bùyào dīgū zìjǐ de nénglì.

def_en: Absolutely necessary or essential
def_zh: 至关重要的 zhìguān zhòngyào de；必需的 bìxū de
quote_en: Water and sleep are vital for growing bodies, which is why I try to drink enough and go to bed early.
quote_zh: 水和睡眠对正在成长的身体至关重要，所以我尽量多喝水、早睡觉。 Shuǐ hé shuìmián duì zhèngzài chéngzhǎng de shēntǐ zhìguān zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ jǐnliàng duō hē shuǐ, zǎo shuìjiào.
ex_en: A positive attitude is vital for overcoming challenges—it turns obstacles into opportunities to grow.
ex_zh: 积极的心态对克服挑战至关重要——它能把障碍变成成长的机会。 Jījí de xīntài duì kèfú tiǎozhàn zhìguān zhòngyào——tā néng bǎ zhàng'ài biànchéng chéngzhǎng de jīhuì.

def_en: To state that something is true without proof
def_zh: 声称 shēngchēng；断言 duànyán
quote_en: My little brother likes to claim that he caught the biggest fish, even though he was napping.
quote_zh: 我的小弟弟喜欢声称他钓到了最大的鱼，尽管他当时在打瞌睡。 Wǒ de xiǎo dìdi xǐhuān shēngchēng tā diàodàole zuìdà de yú, jǐnguǎn tā dāngshí zài dǎ kēshuì.
ex_en: Instead of making claims you can't back up, let your actions speak for themselves—they never lie.
ex_zh: 与其做出无法证实的声称，不如让你的行动为自己说话——行动从不说谎。 Yǔqí zuòchū wúfǎ zhèngshí de shēngchēng, bùrú ràng nǐ de xíngdòng wèi zìjǐ shuōhuà——xíngdòng cóng bù shuōhuǎng.

def_en: The circumstances or setting surrounding a situation or word
def_zh: 背景 bèijǐng；语境 yǔjìng
quote_en: When I didn't understand the word, I looked at the context of the sentence to figure out its meaning.
quote_zh: 当我不理解某个词时，我会看句子的上下文来推测它的意思。 Dāng wǒ bù lǐjiě mǒu gè cí shí, wǒ huì kàn jùzi de shàngxiàwén lái tuīcè tā de yìsi.
ex_en: Before judging someone, understand their context—everyone has a story you know nothing about.
ex_zh: 在评判别人之前，先了解他们的背景——每个人都有你不了解的故事。 Zài píngpàn biérén zhīqián, xiān liǎojiě tāmen de bèijǐng——měi gèrén dōu yǒu nǐ bù liǎojiě de gùshì.

def_en: Scattered pieces of waste or remains
def_zh: 碎片 suìpiàn；残骸 cánhái
quote_en: After the windstorm, there was debris from branches and leaves all over the playground.
quote_zh: 暴风雨过后，操场上到处都是树枝和树叶的残渣。 Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, cāochǎng shàng dàochù dōu shì shùzhī hé shùyè de cánzhā.
ex_en: Clear away the debris of yesterday's mistakes—they don't belong in the path of your future.
ex_zh: 清除昨日错误的碎片——它们不属于你通往未来的道路。 Qīngchú zuórì cuòwù de suìpiàn——tāmen bù shǔyú nǐ tōngwǎng wèilái de dàolù.

def_en: Strange and frightening
def_zh: 怪异而可怕的 guàiyì ér kěpà de；阴森的 yīnsēn de
quote_en: The empty school hallway at night looked eerie with only the emergency lights glowing.
quote_zh: 夜晚空荡荡的学校走廊在只有应急灯亮着时显得阴森可怕。 Yèwǎn kōngdàngdàng de xuéxiào zǒuláng zài zhǐyǒu yìngjí dēng liàngzhe shí xiǎndé yīnsēn kěpà.
ex_en: What seems eerie at first can become familiar once you understand it—knowledge chases away fear.
ex_zh: 一开始觉得可怕的事物，一旦你理解了就会变得熟悉——知识能驱散恐惧。 Yī kāishǐ juéde kěpà de shìwù, yīdàn nǐ lǐjiěle jiù huì biàn dé shúxī——zhīshi néng qūsàn kǒngjù.

def_en: A visual image or design
def_zh: 图形 túxíng；图表 túbiǎo
quote_en: My poster included colorful graphics that showed the life cycle of a butterfly.
quote_zh: 我的海报包含了色彩鲜艳的图形，展示了蝴蝶的生命周期。 Wǒ de hǎibào bāohánle sècǎi xiānyàn de túxíng, zhǎnshìle húdié de shēngmìng zhōuqī.
ex_en: A picture can be a graphic that tells a story words cannot—creativity has many languages.
ex_zh: 一幅图画可以是讲述文字无法表达的故事的图形——创造力有多种语言。 Yī fú túhuà kěyǐ shì jiǎngshù wénzì wúfǎ biǎodá de gùshì de túxíng——chuàngzàolì yǒu duō zhǒng yǔyán.

def_en: To examine or study something carefully
def_zh: 调查 diàochá；侦查 zhēnchá
quote_en: Our class had to investigate why some plants grew taller than others in the school garden.
quote_zh: 我们班要调查为什么学校花园里有些植物比其他的长得更高。 Wǒmen bān yào diàochá wèishénme xuéxiào huāyuán lǐ yǒuxiē zhíwù bǐ qítā de zhǎng dé gèng gāo.
ex_en: When you investigate questions you don't understand, you become a detective in the mystery of learning.
ex_zh: 当你调查自己不懂的问题时，你就成了学习之谜中的侦探。 Dāng nǐ diàochá zìjǐ bù dǒng de wèntí shí, nǐ jiù chéngle xuéxí zhī mí zhōng de zhēntàn.

def_en: Not following a regular pattern; uneven
def_zh: 不规则的 bù guīzé de；不整齐的 bù zhěngqí de
quote_en: The irregular shape of the rock made it perfect for skipping across the water.
quote_zh: 这块石头不规则的形状让它很适合打水漂。 Zhè kuài shítou bù guīzé de xíngzhuàng ràng tā hěn shìhé dǎ shuǐpiāo.
ex_en: Life's path is often irregular—full of twists and turns—but that's what makes the journey interesting.
ex_zh: 人生的道路常常是不规则的——充满了曲折——但这正是旅途有趣之处。 Rénshēng de dàolù chángcháng shì bù guīzé de——chōngmǎnle qūzhé——dàn zhè zhèngshì lǚtú yǒuqù zhī chù.

def_en: To make a soft, crackling sound like leaves or paper
def_zh: 发出沙沙声 fāchū shāshā shēng
quote_en: I could hear the leaves rustle under my feet as I walked through the park.
quote_zh: 我走过公园时，能听到脚下树叶发出的沙沙声。 Wǒ zǒuguò gōngyuán shí, néng tīng dào jiǎo xià shùyè fāchū de shāshā shēng.
ex_en: When you rustle up courage to try something new, you discover strengths you never knew you had.
ex_zh: 当你鼓起勇气尝试新事物时，你会发现自己从未意识到的力量。 Dāng nǐ gǔqǐ yǒngqì chángshì xīn shìwù shí, nǐ huì fāxiàn zìjǐ cóngwèi yìshí dào de lìliang.

def_en: Thin and weak-looking
def_zh: 瘦骨嶙峋的 shòugǔlínxún de；瘦弱的 shòuruò de
quote_en: The scrawny kitten we found grew into a healthy, fluffy cat after we fed her properly.
quote_zh: 我们发现的那只瘦骨嶙峋的小猫，在我们好好喂养之后长成了一只健康毛茸茸的大猫。 Wǒmen fāxiàn de nà zhī shòugǔlínxún de xiǎomāo, zài wǒmen hǎohǎo wèiyǎng zhīhòu zhǎng chéngle yī zhī jiànkāng máorōngróng de dà māo.
ex_en: A scrawny sapling can grow into a mighty oak—with care and time, even the smallest can become strong.
ex_zh: 一棵瘦弱的小树苗可以长成高大的橡树——只要给予关爱和时间，再渺小的存在也能变得强大。 Yī kē shòuruò de xiǎo shùmiáo kěyǐ zhǎng chéng gāodà de xiàngshù——zhǐyào jǐyǔ guān'ài hé shíjiān, zài miǎoxiǎo de cúnzài yě néng biàn dé qiángdà.

def_en: Regular payment for work done
def_zh: 工资 gōngzī；报酬 bàochou
quote_en: My older sister saves part of her wage from her part-time job to buy books for the school library.
quote_zh: 我姐姐把兼职工作挣的部分工资存起来，为学校图书馆买书。 Wǒ jiějie bǎ jiānzhí gōngzuò zhèng de bùfèn gōngzī cún qǐlái, wèi xuéxiào túshūguǎn mǎi shū.
ex_en: The wage for hard work is not just money—it's the pride that comes from knowing you earned it.
ex_zh: 辛勤工作的回报不仅仅是金钱——还有知道自己靠努力换来的那份自豪感。 Xīnqín gōngzuò de huíbào bùjǐnjǐn shì jīnqián——háiyǒu zhīdào zìjǐ kào nǔlì huàn lái de nà fèn zìháogǎn.

def_en: To influence or cause a change in something
def_zh: 影响 yǐngxiǎng
quote_en: The amount of sleep I get really affects how well I do on my spelling tests.
quote_zh: 我睡眠的多少确实会影响我在拼写测试中的表现。 Wǒ shuìmián de duōshǎo quèshí huì yǐngxiǎng wǒ zài pīnxiě cèshì zhōng de biǎoxiàn.
ex_en: Your choices affect more than just you—a single kind act can ripple out and touch many lives.
ex_zh: 你的选择影响的不仅是你自己——一个小小的善意举动可以像涟漪一样扩散，触动许多生命。 Nǐ de xuǎnzé yǐngxiǎng de bùjǐn shì nǐ zìjǐ——yī gè xiǎoxiǎo de shànyì jǔdòng kěyǐ xiàng liányī yīyàng kuòsàn, chùdòng xǔduō shēngmìng.

def_en: The complete loss of hope
def_zh: 绝望 juéwàng
quote_en: Even when I felt despair about learning fractions, my tutor helped me understand step by step.
quote_zh: 即使我对学习分数感到绝望时，我的家教还是一步一步地帮我理解。 Jíshǐ wǒ duì xuéxí fēnshù gǎndào juéwàng shí, wǒ de jiājiào háishì yī bù yī bù de bāng wǒ lǐjiě.
ex_en: Despair is a dark cloud that passes—hold on, because sunshine always follows if you wait.
ex_zh: 绝望是一片会飘走的乌云——坚持住，因为只要你等待，阳光总会到来。 Juéwàng shì yī piàn huì piāo zǒu de wūyún——jiānchí zhù, yīnwèi zhǐyào nǐ děngdài, yángguāng zǒng huì dàolái.

def_en: To discover or notice something
def_zh: 察觉 chájué；发现 fāxiàn
quote_en: My dog can detect the sound of my dad's car from three blocks away.
quote_zh: 我的狗能察觉到三个街区外爸爸汽车的声音。 Wǒ de gǒu néng chájué dào sān gè jiēqū wài bàba qìchē de shēngyīn.
ex_en: Train your eyes to detect small beauties—a dewdrop on a leaf can hold the whole morning's wonder.
ex_zh: 训练你的眼睛去发现微小的美好——叶子上的一滴露珠也能承载整个清晨的奇妙。 Xùnliàn nǐ de yǎnjīng qù fāxiàn wēixiǎo de měihǎo——yèzi shàng de yī dī lùzhū yě néng chéngzài zhěnggè qīngchén de qímiào.

def_en: On the outside or coming from outside
def_zh: 外部的 wàibù de；外在的 wàizài de
quote_en: The external appearance of the old house was worn, but the inside was beautifully renovated.
quote_zh: 那栋老房子的外观很破旧，但里面装修得很漂亮。 Nà dòng lǎo fángzi de wàiguān hěn pòjiù, dàn lǐmiàn zhuāngxiū de hěn piàoliang.
ex_en: External things like prizes fade, but who you are inside—your kindness and courage—lasts forever.
ex_zh: 外在的东西如奖杯会褪色，但你内心的品质——你的善良和勇气——会永远存在。 Wàizài de dōngxi rú jiǎngbēi huì tuìsè, dàn nǐ nèixīn de pǐnzhì——nǐ de shànliáng hé yǒngqì——huì yǒngyuǎn cúnzài.

def_en: A small, bright flash of light
def_zh: 微光 wēiguāng；闪光 shǎnguāng
quote_en: I saw a gleam of sunlight through the clouds after the storm ended.
quote_zh: 暴风雨过后，我看到一缕阳光透过云层闪烁。 Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒ kàndào yī lǚ yángguāng tòuguò yúncéng shǎnshuò.
ex_en: There is a gleam of possibility in every challenge—look for it, and you'll find a way forward.
ex_zh: 每一个挑战中都有一丝可能性在闪烁——去寻找它，你就会找到前进的路。 Měi yī gè tiǎozhàn zhōng dōu yǒu yī sī kěnéngxìng zài shǎnshuò——qù xúnzhǎo tā, nǐ jiù huì zhǎodào qiánjìn de lù.

def_en: On the inside; within something
def_zh: 内部的 nèibù de；内在的 nèizài de
quote_en: My internal excitement grew as the day of the field trip got closer and closer.
quote_zh: 随着郊游的日子越来越近，我内心的兴奋也越来越强烈。 Suízhe jiāoyóu de rìzi yuè lái yuè jìn, wǒ nèixīn de xīngfèn yě yuè lái yuè qiángliè.
ex_en: True strength comes from internal peace—when you are calm inside, nothing outside can shake you easily.
ex_zh: 真正的力量来自内心的平静——当你内心安宁时，外界的事物就很难轻易动摇你。 Zhēnzhèng de lìliang láizì nèixīn de píngjìng——dāng nǐ nèixīn ānníng shí, wàijiè de shìwù jiù hěn nán qīngyì dòngyáo nǐ.

def_en: Serious danger
def_zh: 危险 wēixiǎn；险境 xiǎnjìng
quote_en: The sign warned of peril if we climbed the fence near the construction site.
quote_zh: 警示牌提醒我们如果攀爬工地附近的围栏会有危险。 Jǐngshìpái tíxǐng wǒmen rúguǒ pānpá gōngdì fùjìn de wéilán huì yǒu wēixiǎn.
ex_en: Facing peril with courage doesn't mean you aren't scared—it means you move forward anyway.
ex_zh: 勇敢面对危险并不意味着你不害怕——而是尽管害怕，你仍然继续前行。 Yǒnggǎn miànduì wēixiǎn bìng bù yìwèizhe nǐ bù hàipà——ér shì jǐnguǎn hàipà, nǐ réngrán jìxù qiánxíng.

def_en: To limit or control something
def_zh: 限制 xiànzhì；约束 yuēshù
quote_en: My parents restrict my screen time so I have more hours to play outside and read.
quote_zh: 我的父母限制我看屏幕的时间，这样我就有更多时间在户外玩耍和阅读。 Wǒ de fùmǔ xiànzhì wǒ kàn píngmù de shíjiān, zhèyàng wǒ jiù yǒu gèng duō shíjiān zài hùwài wánshuǎ hé yuèdú.
ex_en: Don't restrict your dreams to what seems possible—the impossible just takes a little longer.
ex_zh: 不要把你的梦想限制在看起来可能的事情上——所谓的不可能只是需要多花一点时间。 Bùyào bǎ nǐ de mèngxiǎng xiànzhì zài kàn qǐlái kěnéng de shìqíng shàng——suǒwèi de bù kěnéng zhǐshì xūyào duō huā yīdiǎn shíjiān.

def_en: Safe and protected
def_zh: 安全的 ānquán de；牢固的 láogù de
quote_en: I feel secure walking to school because there's always a crossing guard at the busy street.
quote_zh: 我走路去上学时感到很安全，因为在繁忙的街道上总有一位交通协管员。 Wǒ zǒulù qù shàngxué shí gǎndào hěn ānquán, yīnwèi zài fánmáng de jiēdào shàng zǒng yǒu yī wèi jiāotōng xiéguǎnyuán.
ex_en: The most secure feeling comes not from locks, but from knowing you have people who care about you.
ex_zh: 最安心的感觉不是来自锁具，而是来自知道有人关心你。 Zuì ānxīn de gǎnjué bùshì láizì suǒjù, ér shì láizì zhīdào yǒu rén guānxīn nǐ.

def_en: A brief statement of the main points
def_zh: 总结 zǒngjié；概要 gàiyào
quote_en: After finishing each chapter, I wrote a short summary to help me remember what happened.
quote_zh: 每读完一章，我都会写一个简短的总结来帮助我记住故事内容。 Měi dú wán yī zhāng, wǒ dōu huì xiě yī gè jiǎnduǎn de zǒngjié lái bāngzhù wǒ jìzhù gùshì nèiróng.
ex_en: A summary captures the heart of a story—similarly, your best moments capture the heart of who you are.
ex_zh: 总结抓住了故事的核心——同样，你最美好的时刻也抓住了你内心的本质。 Zǒngjié zhuāzhùle gùshì de héxīn——tóngyàng, nǐ zuì měihǎo de shíkè yě zhuāzhùle nǐ nèixīn de běnzhì.

def_en: To gently persuade someone to do something
def_zh: 哄劝 hǒngquàn；耐心劝说 nàixīn quànshuō
quote_en: I tried to coax my shy little cousin to join the game by offering to play her favorite card game.
quote_zh: 我试着通过陪表妹玩她最喜欢的纸牌游戏来哄她加入游戏。 Wǒ shìzhe tōngguò péi biǎomèi wán tā zuì xǐhuān de zhǐpái yóuxì lái hǒng tā jiārù yóuxì.
ex_en: Patience can coax open the most hesitant heart—a gentle nudge is sometimes all someone needs.
ex_zh: 耐心能打开最犹豫的心扉——有时候，别人需要的只是一个温柔的推动。 Nàixīn néng dǎkāi zuì yóuyù de xīnfēi——yǒushíhou, biérén xūyào de zhǐshì yī gè wēnróu de tuīdòng.

def_en: To improve or add value to something
def_zh: 增强 zēngqiáng；提高 tígāo
quote_en: Adding colorful pictures will enhance my book report and make it more interesting.
quote_zh: 添加彩色的图画会增强我的读书报告，让它更有趣。 Tiānjiā cǎisè de túhuà huì zēngqiáng wǒ de dúshū bàogào, ràng tā gèng yǒuqù.
ex_en: Learning new skills doesn't replace who you are—it enhances you, adding new colors to your palette.
ex_zh: 学习新技能不会取代你本来的样子——它会提升你，为你的调色板增添新的色彩。 Xuéxí xīn jìnéng bùhuì qǔdài nǐ běnlái de yàngzi——tā huì tíshēng nǐ, wèi nǐ de tiáosèbǎn zēngtiān xīn de sècǎi.

def_en: To show or display something publicly
def_zh: 展示 zhǎnshì；展出 zhǎnchū
quote_en: Our art class will exhibit our paintings in the school hallway for everyone to see.
quote_zh: 我们美术课将在学校走廊展示我们的画作，让所有人都能看到。 Wǒmen měishù kè jiāng zài xuéxiào zǒuláng zhǎnshì wǒmen de huàzuò, ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu néng kàndào.
ex_en: You exhibit your character not through words, but through how you treat others every single day.
ex_zh: 你展示你的品格不是通过言语，而是通过每天如何对待他人。 Nǐ zhǎnshì nǐ de pǐngé bùshì tōngguò yányǔ, ér shì tōngguò měitiān rúhé duìdài tārén.

def_en: Well-known from previous experience
def_zh: 熟悉的 shúxī de
quote_en: The smell of freshly baked bread was familiar—it reminded me of visiting my grandma.
quote_zh: 新鲜出炉的面包香味很熟悉——让我想起了去看奶奶的时光。 Xīnxiān chūlú de miànbāo xiāngwèi hěn shúxī——ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐle qù kàn nǎinai de shíguāng.
ex_en: Step outside what is familiar once in a while—that's where the greatest discoveries wait.
ex_zh: 偶尔走出熟悉的环境——最伟大的发现就在那里等待着你。 Ǒu'ěr zǒuchū shúxī de huánjìng——zuì wěidà de fāxiàn jiù zài nàlǐ děngdài zhe nǐ.

def_en: Fierce, violent, or aggressive
def_zh: 凶猛的 xiōngměng de；残暴的 cánbào de
quote_en: The puppy looked ferocious when he growled at the vacuum cleaner, but he was really just scared.
quote_zh: 那只小狗对着吸尘器咆哮时看起来很凶猛，但其实它只是害怕而已。 Nà zhī xiǎogǒu duìzhe xīchénqì páoxiāo shí kàn qǐlái hěn xiōngměng, dàn qíshí tā zhǐshì hàipà éryǐ.
ex_en: Be ferocious in pursuing your dreams—not by hurting others, but by never giving up on yourself.
ex_zh: 在追求梦想时要充满斗志——不是通过伤害他人，而是通过永不放弃自己。 Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng shí yào chōngmǎn dòuzhì——bùshì tōngguò shānghài tārén, ér shì tōngguò yǒngyuǎn bù fàngqì zìjǐ.

def_en: Dark and difficult to see through
def_zh: 阴暗的 yīn'àn de；浑浊的 húnzhuó de
quote_en: The water in the pond was too murky to see the fish swimming below.
quote_zh: 池塘里的水太浑浊了，看不清游在下面的鱼。 Chítáng lǐ de shuǐ tài húnzhuó le, kàn bù qīng yóu zài xiàmiàn de yú.
ex_en: When the future seems murky, take one step forward—clarity often comes with movement.
ex_zh: 当未来显得模糊不清时，先迈出一步——清晰往往随着行动而来。 Dāng wèilái xiǎndé móhú bù qīng shí, xiān mài chū yī bù——qīngxī wǎngwǎng suízhe xíngdòng ér lái.

def_en: The result or consequence of something
def_zh: 结果 jiéguǒ；结局 jiéjú
quote_en: The outcome of our science fair project was better than I expected—we won second place.
quote_zh: 我们科学展项目的结果比我预期的要好——我们获得了第二名。 Wǒmen kēxué zhǎn xiàngmù de jiéguǒ bǐ wǒ yùqī de yào hǎo——wǒmen huòdéle dì èr míng.
ex_en: You can't always control the outcome, but you can always control the effort you give.
ex_zh: 你无法总是控制结果，但你可以永远控制自己付出的努力。 Nǐ wúfǎ zǒngshì kòngzhì jiéguǒ, dàn nǐ kěyǐ yǒngyuǎn kòngzhì zìjǐ fùchū de nǔlì.

def_en: To hold back or control
def_zh: 克制 kèzhì；阻止 zǔzhǐ
quote_en: I had to restrain myself from eating all the cookies so there would be enough for my friends.
quote_zh: 我不得不克制自己不要把饼干全吃完，这样才够分给我的朋友们。 Wǒ bùdébù kèzhì zìjǐ bùyào bǎ bǐnggān quán chī wán, zhèyàng cái gòu fēn gěi wǒ de péngyoumen.
ex_en: Learning to restrain impulsive words takes practice—but it's a skill that builds strong friendships.
ex_zh: 学会克制冲动的话语需要练习——但这是一种能建立深厚友谊的技能。 Xuéhuì kèzhì chōngdòng de huàyǔ xūyào liànxí——dàn zhè shì yī zhǒng néng jiànlì shēnhòu yǒuyì de jìnéng.

def_en: Feeling or showing sadness
def_zh: 悲伤的 bēishāng de；难过的 nánguò de
quote_en: I felt sorrowful when my best friend moved away, but we still video chat every week.
quote_zh: 我最好的朋友搬走时我很难过，但我们仍然每周视频通话。 Wǒ zuìhǎo de péngyou bānzǒu shí wǒ hěn nánguò, dàn wǒmen réngrán měi zhōu shìpín tōnghuà.
ex_en: Sorrowful moments remind us how much we care—they make us appreciate the people we love even more.
ex_zh: 悲伤的时刻提醒我们有多在乎——它们让我们更加珍惜所爱之人。 Bēishāng de shíkè tíxǐng wǒmen yǒu duō zàihū——tāmen ràng wǒmen gèngjiā zhēnxī suǒ ài zhī rén.

def_en: Understanding and sharing another person's feelings
def_zh: 同情 tóngqíng；同情心 tóngqíngxīn
quote_en: My classmates showed sympathy by sending get-well cards when I was home with the flu.
quote_zh: 我因流感在家时，同学们送来了慰问卡表示关心。 Wǒ yīn liúgǎn zàijiā shí, tóngxuémen sòng láile wèiwènkǎ biǎoshì guānxīn.
ex_en: Sympathy is seeing someone's pain; kindness is doing something to help lighten their load.
ex_zh: 同情是看见别人的痛苦；善良是做一些事情来减轻他们的负担。 Tóngqíng shì kànjiàn biérén de tòngkǔ；shànliáng shì zuò yīxiē shìqíng lái jiǎnqīng tāmen de fùdān.

def_en: Suitable or proper for the situation
def_zh: 合适的 héshì de；恰当的 qiàdàng de
quote_en: Wearing my school uniform was the appropriate choice for the class photo day.
quote_zh: 穿校服是班级拍照日合适的选择。 Chuān xiàofú shì bānjí pāizhào rì héshì de xuǎnzé.
ex_en: Choosing appropriate words shows respect—speak with kindness, and others will listen more willingly.
ex_zh: 选择恰当的言辞是尊重的表现——用善意的话语表达，别人会更愿意倾听。 Xuǎnzé qiàdàng de yáncí shì zūnzhòng de biǎoxiàn——yòng shànyì de huàyǔ biǎodá, biérén huì gèng yuànyì qīngtīng.

def_en: Almost exact but not perfectly accurate
def_zh: 大约的 dàyuē de；近似的 jìnsì de
quote_en: The approximate number of books in our classroom library is two hundred.
quote_zh: 我们班级图书角的书大约有两百本。 Wǒmen bānjí túshū jiǎo de shū dàyuē yǒu liǎng bǎi běn.
ex_en: An approximate answer with effort is better than no answer at all—trying matters more than perfection.
ex_zh: 一个付出了努力的近似答案比完全没有答案要好——尝试比完美更重要。 Yī gè fùchūle nǔlì de jìnsì dá'àn bǐ wánquán méiyǒu dá'àn yào hǎo——chángshì bǐ wánměi gèng zhòngyào.

def_en: To bring something to an end; to decide after reasoning
def_zh: 结束 jiéshù；得出结论 déchū jiélùn
quote_en: We will conclude our unit on space by visiting the science museum next Friday.
quote_zh: 我们将通过下周五参观科学博物馆来结束太空单元的学习。 Wǒmen jiāng tōngguò xià zhōu wǔ cānguān kēxué bówùguǎn lái jiéshù tàikōng dānyuán de xuéxí.
ex_en: Every ending helps you conclude one chapter so you can begin a new one with fresh energy.
ex_zh: 每一个结束都帮助你完结一个篇章，这样你就能以崭新的能量开启新的旅程。 Měi yī gè jiéshù dōu bāngzhù nǐ wánjié yī gè piānzhāng, zhèyàng nǐ jiù néng yǐ zhǎnxīn de néngliàng kāiqǐ xīn de lǚchéng.

def_en: To burst out suddenly; to explode
def_zh: 爆发 bàofā；喷发 pēnfā
quote_en: Laughter erupted from our classroom when the teacher told a funny joke about a clumsy penguin.
quote_zh: 当老师讲了一个关于笨拙企鹅的笑话时，教室里爆发出阵阵笑声。 Dāng lǎoshī jiǎngle yī gè guānyú bènzhuō qì'é de xiàohuà shí, jiàoshì lǐ bàofā chū zhènzhèn xiàoshēng.
ex_en: When emotions erupt, take a breath—calm words can cool what angry shouts might burn.
ex_zh: 当情绪爆发时，深呼吸一下——平静的话语能平息愤怒喊叫可能造成的伤害。 Dāng qíngxù bàofā shí, shēn hūxī yīxià——píngjìng de huàyǔ néng píngxī fènnù hǎnjiào kěnéng zàochéng de shānghài.

def_en: Serious, harsh, or gloomy
def_zh: 严峻的 yánjùn de；阴沉的 yīnchén de
quote_en: The sky looked grim with dark clouds, so we moved our soccer game indoors.
quote_zh: 天空乌云密布，看起来很阴沉，于是我们把足球比赛移到了室内。 Tiānkōng wūyún mìbù, kàn qǐlái hěn yīnchén, yúshì wǒmen bǎ zúqiú bǐsài yídàole shìnèi.
ex_en: Even in grim moments, look for a tiny spark of hope—it can grow into the light you need.
ex_zh: 即使在严峻的时刻，也要寻找那一丝希望的火花——它能成长为你需要的光芒。 Jíshǐ zài yánjùn de shíkè, yě yào xúnzhǎo nà yī sī xīwàng de huǒhuā——tā néng chéngzhǎng wéi nǐ xūyào de guāngmáng.

def_en: To copy someone's actions or speech
def_zh: 模仿 mófǎng
quote_en: My little brother tries to imitate my basketball moves, even though he can barely reach the hoop.
quote_zh: 我的小弟弟试图模仿我打篮球的动作，尽管他连篮筐都够不着。 Wǒ de xiǎo dìdi shìtú mófǎng wǒ dǎ lánqiú de dòngzuò, jǐnguǎn tā lián lánkuāng dōu gòu bù zháo.
ex_en: It's okay to imitate those you admire—but add your own twist, because you have something unique to share.
ex_zh: 模仿你钦佩的人是可以的——但要加入你自己的特色，因为你有独特的东西可以分享。 Mófǎng nǐ qīnpèi de rén shì kěyǐ de——dàn yào jiārù nǐ zìjǐ de tèsè, yīnwèi nǐ yǒu dútè de dōngxi kěyǐ fēnxiǎng.

def_en: To demand or state firmly
def_zh: 坚持 jiānchí；坚决要求 jiānjué yāoqiú
quote_en: My mom insists that I finish my homework before I can play video games.
quote_zh: 我妈妈坚持要我完成作业后才能玩电子游戏。 Wǒ māma jiānchí yào wǒ wánchéng zuòyè hòu cáinéng wán diànzǐ yóuxì.
ex_en: When you insist on doing your best, even on hard days, you build a habit that leads to great things.
ex_zh: 当你坚持全力以赴，即使是在艰难的日子里，你也在养成一种通往伟大的习惯。 Dāng nǐ jiānchí quánlì yǐfù, jíshǐ shì zài jiānnán de rìzi lǐ, nǐ yě zài yǎngchéng yī zhǒng tōngwǎng wěidà de xíguàn.

def_en: To smile or speak in a mocking or scornful way
def_zh: 嘲笑 cháoxiào；冷笑 lěngxiào
quote_en: The older boy would sneer at my drawings until I entered the art competition and won.
quote_zh: 那个大一点的男孩总是嘲笑我的画，直到我参加美术比赛并获奖。 Nàgè dà yīdiǎn de nánhái zǒngshì cháoxiào wǒ de huà, zhídào wǒ cānjiā měishù bǐsài bìng huòjiǎng.
ex_en: A sneer can hurt, but kindness heals—choose to be someone who builds others up instead of tearing them down.
ex_zh: 嘲笑会伤人，但善意能治愈——选择做一个建造他人、而非拆毁他人的人。 Cháoxiào huì shāngrén, dàn shànyì néng zhìyù——xuǎnzé zuò yī gè jiànzào tārén, ér fēi chāihuǐ tārén de rén.

def_en: A small bunch or cluster of something
def_zh: 一簇 yī cù；一束 yī shù
quote_en: A tuft of grass was growing through a crack in the sidewalk, showing how nature finds a way.
quote_zh: 一簇草从人行道的裂缝中长出来，展示着大自然总能找到出路。 Yī cù cǎo cóng rénxíngdào de lièfèng zhōng zhǎng chūlái, zhǎnshìzhe dàzìrán zǒng néng zhǎodào chūlù.
ex_en: Like a tuft of grass pushing through concrete, your determination can help you overcome any obstacle.
ex_zh: 就像一簇草从混凝土中钻出来一样，你的决心能帮助你克服任何障碍。 Jiù xiàng yī cù cǎo cóng hùnníngtǔ zhōng zuān chūlái yīyàng, nǐ de juéxīn néng bāngzhù nǐ kèfú rènhé zhàng'ài.

def_en: To undo or untangle; to solve or figure out
def_zh: 解开 jiěkāi；理清 lǐqīng
quote_en: It took me ten minutes to unravel the tangled knot in my shoelace before gym class.
quote_zh: 我花了十分钟才解开体育课前鞋带上那个缠在一起的结。 Wǒ huāle shí fēnzhōng cái jiěkāi tǐyù kè qián xiédài shàng nàgè chán zài yīqǐ de jié.
ex_en: When problems seem tangled, take time to unravel them slowly—patience solves what rushing cannot.
ex_zh: 当问题看似一团乱麻时，花点时间慢慢解开——耐心能解决急躁无法处理的问题。 Dāng wèntí kànsì yī tuán luànmá shí, huā diǎn shíjiān mànmàn jiěkāi——nàixīn néng jiějué jízào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de wèntí.

def_en: Ready to attack or confront; forceful
def_zh: 好斗的 hàodòu de；侵略性的 qīnlüè xìng de
quote_en: The aggressive player kept trying to steal the ball, so I learned to protect it better.
quote_zh: 那个好斗的球员一直试图抢断球，于是我学会了更好地保护球。 Nàgè hàodòu de qiúyuán yīzhí shìtú qiǎngduàn qiú, yúshì wǒ xuéhuìle gèng hǎo de bǎohù qiú.
ex_en: You can be aggressive in chasing your dreams without being aggressive toward people—strength can be kind.
ex_zh: 你可以在追求梦想时充满冲劲，而不对人充满攻击性——力量也可以是温和的。 Nǐ kěyǐ zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng shí chōngmǎn chōngjìn, ér bù duì rén chōngmǎn gōngjī xìng——lìliang yě kěyǐ shì wēnhé de.

def_en: Worried or nervous about something
def_zh: 焦虑的 jiāolǜ de；担心的 dānxīn de
quote_en: I felt anxious before the math test, but deep breaths helped me calm down and focus.
quote_zh: 数学考试前我感到很焦虑，但深呼吸帮助我平静下来集中注意力。 Shùxué kǎoshì qián wǒ gǎndào hěn jiāolǜ, dàn shēn hūxī bāngzhù wǒ píngjìng xiàlái jízhōng zhùyìlì.
ex_en: Everyone feels anxious sometimes—it's a sign that you care, and courage is moving forward anyway.
ex_zh: 每个人有时都会感到焦虑——这说明你在乎，而勇气就是无论如何都要继续前行。 Měi gèrén yǒushí dōu huì gǎndào jiāolǜ——zhè shuōmíng nǐ zàihū, ér yǒngqì jiùshì wúlùn rúhé dōu yào jìxù qiánxíng.

def_en: Completely confused or puzzled
def_zh: 困惑的 kùnhuò de；不知所措的 bùzhī suǒcuò de
quote_en: I was bewildered by the complicated instructions for my new board game.
quote_zh: 我被新桌游那复杂的说明弄糊涂了。 Wǒ bèi xīn zhuōyóu nà fùzá de shuōmíng nòng hútú le.
ex_en: When you feel bewildered, ask questions—curiosity turns confusion into understanding.
ex_zh: 当你感到困惑时，就提问——好奇心能把困惑变成理解。 Dāng nǐ gǎndào kùnhuò shí, jiù tíwèn——hàoqíxīn néng bǎ kùnhuò biànchéng lǐjiě.

def_en: The quality of being kind and giving
def_zh: 慷慨 kāngkǎi；大方 dàfāng
quote_en: My friend showed generosity by sharing her lunch with me when I forgot mine.
quote_zh: 我的朋友很大方，在我忘记带午餐时把她的一半分给了我。 Wǒ de péngyou hěn dàfāng, zài wǒ wàngjì dài wǔcān shí bǎ tā de yībàn fēn gěile wǒ.
ex_en: Generosity isn't about how much you give—it's about the joy in your heart when you share what you have.
ex_zh: 慷慨不在于你给予多少——而在于你分享时所怀的那份喜悦。 Kāngkǎi bù zàiyú nǐ jǐyǔ duōshǎo——ér zàiyú nǐ fēnxiǎng shí suǒ huái de nà fèn xǐyuè.

def_en: A deep understanding of something
def_zh: 洞察力 dòngchálì；深刻见解 shēnkè jiànjiě
quote_en: Reading the biography gave me insight into how the inventor came up with her ideas.
quote_zh: 读那本传记让我深入了解那位发明家是如何产生灵感的。 Dú nà běn zhuànjì ràng wǒ shēnrù liǎojiě nà wèi fāmíngjiā shì rúhé chǎnshēng línggǎn de.
ex_en: Every book offers insight into lives different from your own—reading builds understanding and kindness.
ex_zh: 每一本书都提供了解与你不同人生的视角——阅读培养理解与善意。 Měi yī běn shū dōu tígōngle liǎojiě yǔ nǐ bùtóng rénshēng de shìjiǎo——yuèdú péiyǎng lǐjiě yǔ shànyì.

def_en: Deserving pity; sadly inadequate
def_zh: 可怜的 kělián de；令人同情的 lìngrén tóngqíng de
quote_en: The pitiful cries of the lost puppy made everyone in the neighborhood search for its owner.
quote_zh: 那只走失小狗可怜的叫声让整个街区的人都在帮它寻找主人。 Nà zhī zǒushī xiǎogǒu kělián de jiàoshēng ràng zhěnggè jiēqū de rén dōu zài bāng tā xúnzhǎo zhǔrén.
ex_en: A pitiful moment doesn't define your whole story—tomorrow is a new page waiting to be written.
ex_zh: 一个可怜的时刻并不能定义你的整个人生故事——明天是一页等待书写的新篇章。 Yī gè kělián de shíkè bìng bùnéng dìngyì nǐ de zhěnggè rénshēng gùshì——míngtiān shì yī yè děngdài shūxiě de xīn piānzhāng.

def_en: Most important; main; first in order
def_zh: 首要的 shǒuyào de；主要的 zhǔyào de；初级的 chūjí de
quote_en: My primary goal this year is to improve my reading skills so I can enjoy longer books.
quote_zh: 我今年的主要目标是提高阅读能力，这样我就能享受更长的书籍。 Wǒ jīnnián de zhǔyào mùbiāo shì tígāo yuèdú nénglì, zhèyàng wǒ jiù néng xiǎngshòu gèng cháng de shūjí.
ex_en: Kindness should be your primary guide—it leads you to choices you'll always be proud of.
ex_zh: 善良应该是你首要的指南——它会引导你做出永远引以为豪的选择。 Shànliáng yīnggāi shì nǐ shǒuyào de zhǐnán——tā huì yǐndǎo nǐ zuòchū yǒngyuǎn yǐn yǐ wéi háo de xuǎnzé.

def_en: Genuine and honest; without pretense
def_zh: 真诚的 zhēnchéng de；诚挚的 chéngzhì de
quote_en: A sincere apology from my friend made me feel better after our argument.
quote_zh: 朋友真诚的道歉让我们争吵之后我心里好受多了。 Péngyou zhēnchéng de dàoqiàn ràng wǒmen zhēngchǎo zhīhòu wǒ xīnli hǎoshòu duōle.
ex_en: A sincere compliment costs nothing but can brighten someone's whole day—share them freely.
ex_zh: 一句真诚的赞美无需分文，却能点亮别人一整天——大方地分享它们吧。 Yī jù zhēnchéng de zànměi wúxū fēnwén, què néng diǎnliàng biérén yī zhěngtiān——dàfāng de fēnxiǎng tāmen ba.

def_en: Slow-moving; lacking energy
def_zh: 缓慢的 huǎnmàn de；无精打采的 wújīngdǎcǎi de
quote_en: I felt sluggish in the morning until I ate breakfast and woke up completely.
quote_zh: 早上我还没吃早饭、完全醒来之前，感觉整个人都没精打采的。 Zǎoshang wǒ hái méi chī zǎofàn, wánquán xǐnglái zhīqián, gǎnjué zhěnggèrén dōu méijīngdǎcǎi de.
ex_en: When you feel sluggish, remember that even the slowest turtle finishes the race—keep going.
ex_zh: 当你感到没精打采时，记住即使最慢的乌龟也能完成比赛——继续前进吧。 Dāng nǐ gǎndào méijīngdǎcǎi shí, jìzhù jíshǐ zuì màn de wūguī yě néng wánchéng bǐsài——jìxù qiánjìn ba.

def_en: To have a strong desire for something
def_zh: 渴望 kěwàng；向往 xiàngwǎng
quote_en: I yearn for the day when I can finally reach the top shelf without asking for help.
quote_zh: 我渴望有一天终于不用求助就能够到最上面的架子。 Wǒ kěwàng yǒu yītiān zhōngyú bùyòng qiúzhù jiù néng gòu dào zuì shàngmiàn de jiàzi.
ex_en: Yearn to learn, yearn to grow—a curious heart will take you places you never imagined.
ex_zh: 渴望学习，渴望成长——一颗好奇的心会带你到达从未想象过的地方。 Kěwàng xuéxí, kěwàng chéngzhǎng——yī kē hàoqí de xīn huì dài nǐ dàodá cóngwèi xiǎngxiàngguò de dìfāng.

def_en: To shrink back in fear or embarrassment
def_zh: 畏缩 wèisuō；感到尴尬 gǎndào gāngà
quote_en: I cringed when I remembered the time I called my teacher "Mom" in front of the whole class.
quote_zh: 想起那次在全班同学面前把老师叫成“妈妈”时，我尴尬得不行。 Xiǎngqǐ nà cì zài quánbān tóngxué miànqián bǎ lǎoshī jiào chéng "māma" shí, wǒ gāngà de bùxíng.
ex_en: We all cringe at past mistakes—they're just proof that you're learning and growing every day.
ex_zh: 我们都曾为过去的错误感到尴尬——它们恰恰证明你每天都在学习和成长。 Wǒmen dōu céng wèi guòqù de cuòwù gǎndào gāngà——tāmen qiàqià zhèngmíng nǐ měitiān dōu zài xuéxí hé chéngzhǎng.

def_en: Sadness or disappointment caused by something unexpected
def_zh: 沮丧 jǔsàng；失望 shīwàng
quote_en: To my dismay, the amusement park was closed just as we arrived at the gate.
quote_zh: 让我失望的是，我们刚到门口，游乐园就关门了。 Ràng wǒ shīwàng de shì, wǒmen gāng dào ménkǒu, yóulèyuán jiù guānmén le.
ex_en: Dismay is temporary—turn it into determination, and you'll find another path to what you want.
ex_zh: 失望是暂时的——把它变成决心，你会找到另一条通往目标的道路。 Shīwàng shì zànshí de——bǎ tā biànchéng juéxīn, nǐ huì zhǎodào lìng yī tiáo tōngwǎng mùbiāo de dàolù.

def_en: Facts or signs that prove something
def_zh: 证据 zhèngjù；证明 zhèngmíng
quote_en: The muddy footprints were evidence that someone had walked through the kitchen.
quote_zh: 泥泞的脚印是有人走过厨房的证据。 Nínìng de jiǎoyìn shì yǒurén zǒuguò chúfáng de zhèngjù.
ex_en: Kindness leaves evidence too—in the smiles of those you've helped and the warmth you've shared.
ex_zh: 善意也会留下证据——在你帮助过的人的笑容里，在你分享过的温暖中。 Shànyì yě huì liúxià zhèngjù——zài nǐ bāngzhù guò de rén de xiàoróng lǐ, zài nǐ fēnxiǎng guò de wēnnuǎn zhōng.

def_en: To show or communicate a thought or feeling
def_zh: 表达 biǎodá；表示 biǎoshì
quote_en: I used a drawing to express how grateful I was for my teacher's help.
quote_zh: 我用一幅画来表达我对老师帮助的感激之情。 Wǒ yòng yī fú huà lái biǎodá wǒ duì lǎoshī bāngzhù de gǎnjī zhī qíng.
ex_en: Finding healthy ways to express your feelings—through words, art, or music—makes your heart lighter.
ex_zh: 找到健康的方式来表达你的感受——通过言语、艺术或音乐——能让你的心更轻松。 Zhǎodào jiànkāng de fāngshì lái biǎodá nǐ de gǎnshòu——tōngguò yányǔ, yìshù huò yīnyuè——néng ràng nǐ de xīn gèng qīngsōng.

def_en: To lift or pull up something heavy
def_zh: 升起 shēngqǐ；举起 jǔqǐ
quote_en: We worked together to hoist the heavy flag to the top of the pole.
quote_zh: 我们齐心协力把那面沉重的旗帜升到了旗杆顶端。 Wǒmen qíxīn xiélì bǎ nà miàn chénzhòng de qízhì shēng dàole qígān dǐngduān.
ex_en: When a task is too heavy to hoist alone, ask for help—teamwork turns heavy loads into shared triumphs.
ex_zh: 当一项任务太重无法独自完成时，就寻求帮助——团队合作能把沉重的负担变成共同的胜利。 Dāng yī xiàng rènwù tài zhòng wúfǎ dúzì wánchéng shí, jiù xúnqiú bāngzhù——tuánduì hézuò néng bǎ chénzhòng de fùdān biànchéng gòngtóng de shènglì.

def_en: To make someone feel ashamed or embarrassed
def_zh: 使蒙羞 shǐ méngxiū；羞辱 xiūrǔ
quote_en: The kind boy never tried to humiliate others when they made mistakes in class.
quote_zh: 那个善良的男孩从不在同学课堂上犯错时让他们难堪。 Nàgè shànliáng de nánhái cóng bù zài tóngxué kètáng shàng fàncuò shí ràng tāmen nánkān.
ex_en: No one deserves to be humiliated—choose to be the person who protects others' dignity, not the one who harms it.
ex_zh: 没有人应该被羞辱——选择做一个保护他人尊严的人，而不是伤害它的人。 Méiyǒu rén yīnggāi bèi xiūrǔ——xuǎnzé zuò yī gè bǎohù tārén zūnyán de rén, ér bùshì shānghài tā de rén.

def_en: Useful and sensible; related to actual practice
def_zh: 实用的 shíyòng de；实际的 shíjì de
quote_en: My mom gave me practical advice: pack my backpack the night before to save time in the morning.
quote_zh: 妈妈给了我一个实用的建议：前一晚把书包收拾好，这样早上就能省时间。 Māma gěile wǒ yī gè shíyòng de jiànyì：qián yī wǎn bǎ shūbāo shōushi hǎo, zhèyàng zǎoshang jiù néng shěng shíjiān.
ex_en: Practical skills like cooking, cleaning, and listening will serve you well for your whole life.
ex_zh: 像做饭、打扫和倾听这样的实用技能，会让你受益终生。 Xiàng zuòfàn, dǎsǎo hé qīngtīng zhèyàng de shíyòng jìnéng, huì ràng nǐ shòuyì zhōngshēng.

def_en: Small and weak
def_zh: 弱小的 ruòxiǎo de；微不足道的 wēibùzúdào de
quote_en: The puny seedling looked fragile, but with water and sunlight it grew taller than me.
quote_zh: 那棵弱小的幼苗看起来很脆弱，但在水和阳光的滋养下，它长得比我还高了。 Nà kē ruòxiǎo de yòumiáo kàn qǐlái hěn cuìruò, dàn zài shuǐ hé yángguāng de zīyǎng xià, tā zhǎng de bǐ wǒ hái gāo le.
ex_en: Even a puny start can lead to something mighty—don't underestimate what small beginnings can become.
ex_zh: 即使是再微小的开始，也能成就一番伟业——不要低估小小起点的潜力。 Jíshǐ shì zài wēixiǎo de kāishǐ, yě néng chéngjiù yī fān wěiyè——bùyào dīgū xiǎoxiǎo qǐdiǎn de qiánlì.

def_en: To flow or spread slowly through small openings
def_zh: 渗漏 shènlòu；渗透 shèntòu
quote_en: Water began to seep through the roof when the rain fell harder than ever.
quote_zh: 雨下得比以往都大时，水开始从屋顶渗进来。 Yǔ xià de bǐ yǐwǎng dōu dà shí, shuǐ kāishǐ cóng wūdǐng shèn jìnlái.
ex_en: Kindness can seep into hearts like sunlight through curtains—a little warmth can change everything.
ex_zh: 善意能像阳光透过窗帘一样渗入心灵——一点温暖就能改变一切。 Shànyì néng xiàng yángguāng tòuguò chuānglián yīyàng shènrù xīnlíng——yī diǎn wēnnuǎn jiù néng gǎibiàn yīqiè.

def_en: Sadly longing for something in the past
def_zh: 渴望的 kěwàng de；惆怅的 chóuchàng de
quote_en: I felt wistful looking at photos from kindergarten, remembering how much fun we had.
quote_zh: 看着幼儿园的照片时，我有些怀念，想起我们度过的快乐时光。 Kànzhe yòuéryuán de zhàopiàn shí, wǒ yǒuxiē huáiniàn, xiǎngqǐ wǒmen dùguò de kuàilè shíguāng.
ex_en: A wistful feeling reminds you of beautiful memories—cherish them, then go make new ones.
ex_zh: 惆怅的心情让你想起美好的回忆——珍惜它们，然后去创造新的回忆吧。 Chóuchàng de xīnqíng ràng nǐ xiǎngqǐ měihǎo de huíyì——zhēnxī tāmen, ránhòu qù chuàngzào xīn de huíyì ba.

def_en: To examine something in detail to understand it
def_zh: 分析 fēnxī
quote_en: In science class, we had to analyse the results of our experiment and explain what we learned.
quote_zh: 科学课上，我们要分析实验结果并解释我们的发现。 Kēxué kè shàng, wǒmen yào fēnxī shíyàn jiéguǒ bìng jiěshì wǒmen de fāxiàn.
ex_en: When you analyse a problem, you turn confusion into a clear path forward—one step at a time.
ex_zh: 当你分析一个问题时，你就是在把困惑变成清晰的解决路径——一步一步来。 Dāng nǐ fēnxī yī gè wèntí shí, nǐ jiùshì zài bǎ kùnhuò biànchéng qīngxī de jiějué lùjìng——yī bù yī bù lái.

def_en: To suppose something without proof
def_zh: 假设 jiǎshè；认为 rènwéi
quote_en: I made the mistake of assuming the test would be easy, so I didn't study enough.
quote_zh: 我犯了一个错误，以为考试很简单，所以没有好好复习。 Wǒ fànle yī gè cuòwù, yǐwéi kǎoshì hěn jiǎndān, suǒyǐ méiyǒu hǎohǎo fùxí.
ex_en: Never assume you know someone's story—listen first, because everyone carries things you can't see.
ex_zh: 永远不要假设你了解别人的故事——先倾听，因为每个人都背负着你无法看见的东西。 Yǒngyuǎn bùyào jiǎshè nǐ liǎojiě biérén de gùshì——xiān qīngtīng, yīnwèi měi gèrén dōu bēifùzhe nǐ wúfǎ kànjiàn de dōngxi.

def_en: To eat hungrily; to read or absorb quickly
def_zh: 狼吞虎咽 lángtūnhǔyàn；如饥似渴地阅读 rújīsìkě de yuèdú
quote_en: I was so hungry after swimming that I devoured my sandwich in three bites.
quote_zh: 游泳之后我太饿了，三口就把三明治吞完了。 Yóuyǒng zhīhòu wǒ tài è le, sān kǒu jiù bǎ sānmíngzhì tūn wán le.
ex_en: When you find a book you love, devour every page—stories have the power to transport you anywhere.
ex_zh: 当你找到一本喜欢的书时，尽情阅读每一页——故事有能力将你带往任何地方。 Dāng nǐ zhǎodào yī běn xǐhuān de shū shí, jìnqíng yuèdú měi yī yè——gùshì yǒu nénglì jiāng nǐ dài wǎng rènhé dìfāng.

def_en: Feeling jealous of someone else's good fortune
def_zh: 嫉妒的 jídù de；羡慕的 xiànmù de
quote_en: I felt envious when my friend showed me her new bike, but then she let me ride it.
quote_zh: 朋友向我展示她的新自行车时我有些羡慕，但后来她让我骑了。 Péngyou xiàng wǒ zhǎnshì tā de xīn zìxíngchē shí wǒ yǒuxiē xiànmù, dàn hòulái tā ràng wǒ qí le.
ex_en: Instead of feeling envious, celebrate others' successes—their happiness doesn't take anything away from you.
ex_zh: 与其感到嫉妒，不如为他人的成功喝彩——他们的快乐并不会从你这里夺走任何东西。 Yǔqí gǎndào jídù, bùrú wèi tārén de chénggōng hècǎi——tāmen de kuàilè bìng bùhuì cóng nǐ zhèlǐ duó zǒu rènhé dōngxi.

def_en: To have an effect on someone or something
def_zh: 影响 yǐngxiǎng
quote_en: My older cousin's love for reading influenced me to try new kinds of books.
quote_zh: 我表哥对阅读的热爱影响了我去尝试不同类型的书。 Wǒ biǎogē duì yuèdú de rè'ài yǐngxiǎngle wǒ qù chángshì bùtóng lèixíng de shū.
ex_en: Your choices influence more than you know—be the kind of influence that makes the world a little brighter.
ex_zh: 你的选择影响的范围远比你想象的要广——成为那种让世界更明亮一点的影响力吧。 Nǐ de xuǎnzé yǐngxiǎng de fànwéi yuǎn bǐ nǐ xiǎngxiàng de yào guǎng——chéngwéi nà zhǒng ràng shìjiè gèng míngliàng yīdiǎn de yǐngxiǎnglì ba.

def_en: To forbid something by rule or law
def_zh: 禁止 jìnzhǐ
quote_en: School rules prohibit running in the hallways to keep everyone safe.
quote_zh: 校规禁止在走廊里奔跑，以保障每个人的安全。 Xiàoguī jìnzhǐ zài zǒuláng lǐ bēnpǎo, yǐ bǎozhàng měi gèrén de ānquán.
ex_en: Don't let fear prohibit you from trying new things—courage grows when you step outside your comfort zone.
ex_zh: 不要让恐惧阻止你尝试新事物——当你走出舒适区时，勇气就会生长。 Bùyào ràng kǒngjù zǔzhǐ nǐ chángshì xīn shìwù——dāng nǐ zǒuchū shūshì qū shí, yǒngqì jiù huì shēngzhǎng.

def_en: To ask about someone's private business; to force open
def_zh: 打听 dǎtīng；撬开 qiàokāi
quote_en: I didn't want to pry, so I waited for my friend to tell me what was bothering her.
quote_zh: 我不想打探隐私，所以等着朋友自己告诉我她在烦恼什么。 Wǒ bùxiǎng dǎtàn yǐnsī, suǒyǐ děngzhe péngyou zìjǐ gàosu wǒ tā zài fánnǎo shénme.
ex_en: A good friend knows when to listen and when not to pry—respecting boundaries builds trust.
ex_zh: 好朋友懂得何时倾听、何时不打探——尊重界限才能建立信任。 Hǎo péngyou dǒngdé héshí qīngtīng, héshí bù dǎtàn——zūnzhòng jièxiàn cáinéng jiànlì xìnrèn.

def_en: To remember something from the past
def_zh: 回忆 huíyì；回想 huíxiǎng
quote_en: I tried to recall where I had put my library book, and finally remembered it was under my bed.
quote_zh: 我努力回忆把图书馆的书放在哪里了，最后想起它在床底下。 Wǒ nǔlì huíyì bǎ túshūguǎn de shū fàng zài nǎlǐ le, zuìhòu xiǎngqǐ tā zài chuáng dǐxià.
ex_en: When you recall a kind act someone did for you, let it inspire you to pass that kindness forward.
ex_zh: 当你回忆起别人对你的善意之举时，让它激励你把这善意传递下去。 Dāng nǐ huíyì qǐ biérén duì nǐ de shànyì zhī jǔ shí, ràng tā jīlì nǐ bǎ zhè shànyì chuándì xiàqù.

def_en: A feeling of sadness about something done or not done
def_zh: 遗憾 yíhàn；后悔 hòuhuǐ
quote_en: My biggest regret was not trying out for the school play—next year I will be brave.
quote_zh: 我最大的遗憾是没有去参加学校话剧的选拔——明年我一定会勇敢。 Wǒ zuìdà de yíhàn shì méiyǒu qù cānjiā xuéxiào huàjù de xuǎnbá——míngnián wǒ yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn.
ex_en: Live so that your regrets are few—take chances, speak kindly, and always try your best.
ex_zh: 让自己的遗憾尽量少一些——抓住机会，言语友善，永远全力以赴。 Ràng zìjǐ de yíhàn jǐnliàng shǎo yīxiē——zhuāzhù jīhuì, yányǔ yǒushàn, yǒngyuǎn quánlì yǐfù.

def_en: To twist and squeeze; to get something with effort
def_zh: 拧 nǐng；绞尽脑汁得到 jiǎojìn nǎozhī dédào
quote_en: I had to wring out my wet swimsuit before putting it in my bag.
quote_zh: 我得把湿泳衣拧干才能放进包里。 Wǒ děi bǎ shī yǒngyī nǐnggān cáinéng fàngjìn bāo lǐ.
ex_en: You may wring your hands with worry, but action solves more than worry ever will—take one small step.
ex_zh: 你可能会焦虑地绞着双手，但行动比担忧更能解决问题——迈出一小步吧。 Nǐ kěnéng huì jiāolǜ de jiǎozhe shuāngshǒu, dàn xíngdòng bǐ dānyōu gèng néng jiějué wèntí——mài chū yī xiǎobù ba.

def_en: To tell someone a secret or private matter
def_zh: 吐露 tǔlù；倾诉 qīngsù
quote_en: I knew I could confide in my best friend because she always keeps my secrets safe.
quote_zh: 我知道可以向最好的朋友倾诉心事，因为她总是替我保守秘密。 Wǒ zhīdào kěyǐ xiàng zuìhǎo de péngyou qīngsù xīnshì, yīnwèi tā zǒngshì tì wǒ bǎoshǒu mìmì.
ex_en: Being someone others can confide in is a gift—it means you've earned their trust through your kindness.
ex_zh: 成为别人可以倾诉的对象是一种礼物——这意味着你通过善意赢得了他们的信任。 Chéngwéi biérén kěyǐ qīngsù de duìxiàng shì yī zhǒng lǐwù——zhè yìwèizhe nǐ tōngguò shànyì yíngdéle tāmen de xìnrèn.

def_en: To fear something that is going to happen
def_zh: 畏惧 wèijù；害怕 hàipà
quote_en: I used to dread giving speeches, but practicing in front of my family made it easier.
quote_zh: 我以前很害怕演讲，但在家人面前练习之后变得容易多了。 Wǒ yǐqián hěn hàipà yǎnjiǎng, dàn zài jiārén miànqián liànxí zhīhòu biàn dé róngyì duōle.
ex_en: Don't dread challenges—embrace them as chances to discover how strong you really are.
ex_zh: 不要畏惧挑战——把它们当作发现自己真正有多强大的机会。 Bùyào wèijù tiǎozhàn——bǎ tāmen dàngzuò fāxiàn zìjǐ zhēnzhèng yǒu duō qiángdà de jīhuì.

def_en: A brief or partial view
def_zh: 一瞥 yī piē；短暂的看到 duǎnzàn de kàndào
quote_en: I caught a glimpse of a deer in the woods before it disappeared behind the trees.
quote_zh: 我在树林里瞥见一只鹿，然后它就消失在树丛后面了。 Wǒ zài shùlín lǐ piējiàn yī zhī lù, ránhòu tā jiù xiāoshī zài shùcóng hòumiàn le.
ex_en: Every book gives you a glimpse into someone else's world—reading builds bridges between hearts.
ex_zh: 每一本书都让你得以一窥他人的世界——阅读在心灵之间架起桥梁。 Měi yī běn shū dōu ràng nǐ déyǐ yī kuī tārén de shìjiè——yuèdú zài xīnlíng zhī jiān jiàqǐ qiáoliáng.

def_en: To shine with a sparkling light
def_zh: 闪耀 shǎnyào；发光 fāguāng
quote_en: The morning dew made the spider web glisten like diamonds in the sunlight.
quote_zh: 清晨的露水让蜘蛛网在阳光下像钻石一样闪耀。 Qīngchén de lùshuǐ ràng zhīzhū wǎng zài yángguāng xià xiàng zuànshí yīyàng shǎnyào.
ex_en: After the rain, everything glistens—sometimes beauty appears after the hardest storms.
ex_zh: 雨后，万物都闪闪发光——有时候，美丽在最大的风雨之后才会出现。 Yǔ hòu, wànwù dōu shǎnshǎn fāguāng——yǒushíhou, měilì zài zuìdà de fēngyǔ zhīhòu cái huì chūxiàn.

def_en: To set apart or separate from others
def_zh: 隔离 gélí；孤立 gūlì
quote_en: When I had a cold, I had to isolate myself so I wouldn't spread germs to my classmates.
quote_zh: 我感冒时不得不把自己隔离起来，以免把病菌传染给同学。 Wǒ gǎnmào shí bùdébù bǎ zìjǐ gélí qǐlái, yǐmiǎn bǎ bìngjūn chuánrǎn gěi tóngxué.
ex_en: When you feel isolated, reach out—connection is just a kind word or a listening ear away.
ex_zh: 当你感到孤立时，伸出手去寻求连接——一段善意的话语或一双倾听的耳朵就能带来连接。 Dāng nǐ gǎndào gūlì shí, shēnchū shǒu qù xúnqiú liánjiē——yī duàn shànyì de huàyǔ huò yī shuāng qīngtīng de ěrduǒ jiù néng dàilái liánjiē.

def_en: A choice or alternative
def_zh: 选择 xuǎnzé；选项 xuǎnxiàng
quote_en: For our project, we had the option to make a poster, build a model, or give a presentation.
quote_zh: 对于我们的作业，我们可以选择制作海报、搭建模型或者做演讲。 Duìyú wǒmen de zuòyè, wǒmen kěyǐ xuǎnzé zhìzuò hǎibào, dājiàn móxíng huòzhě zuò yǎnjiǎng.
ex_en: When life gives you options, choose the one that makes you proud—not just the easiest path.
ex_zh: 当生活给你选项时，选择那个让你感到自豪的——而不仅仅是那条最简单的路。 Dāng shēnghuó gěi nǐ xuǎnxiàng shí, xuǎnzé nàgè ràng nǐ gǎndào zìháo de——ér bùjǐnjǐn shì nà tiáo zuì jiǎndān de lù.

def_en: A short section from a book; a way through
def_zh: 段落 duànluò；通道 tōngdào
quote_en: The passage from our reading book described a magical forest full of talking animals.
quote_zh: 我们阅读书中的那个段落描绘了一片充满会说话动物的魔法森林。 Wǒmen yuèdú shū zhōng de nàgè duànluò miáohuìle yī piàn chōngmǎn huì shuōhuà dòngwù de mófǎ sēnlín.
ex_en: Every passage you read adds a new room to the house of your imagination—fill it with stories.
ex_zh: 你阅读的每一个段落都为你想象力的房子增添一个新的房间——用故事填满它吧。 Nǐ yuèdú de měi yī gè duànluò dōu wèi nǐ xiǎngxiànglì de fángzi zēngtiān yī gè xīn de fángjiān——yòng gùshì tiánmǎn tā ba.

def_en: To smile in an annoying or smug way
def_zh: 得意地笑 déyì de xiào；假笑 jiǎxiào
quote_en: The bully would smirk when he thought he had tricked someone, but his jokes weren't funny.
quote_zh: 那个霸凌者觉得捉弄了别人时就会得意地笑，但他的玩笑一点儿都不好笑。 Nàgè bàlíngzhě juéde zhuōnòngle biérén shí jiù huì déyì de xiào, dàn tā de wánxiào yīdiǎn er dōu bù hǎoxiào.
ex_en: A smirk may seem clever, but a genuine smile costs nothing and spreads real joy.
ex_zh: 得意的笑也许显得聪明，但真诚的微笑无需代价，却能传播真正的快乐。 Déyì de xiào yěxǔ xiǎnde cōngmíng, dàn zhēnchéng de wēixiào wúxū dàijià, què néng chuánbō zhēnzhèng de kuàilè.

def_en: Extremely large in size or extent
def_zh: 广阔的 guǎngkuò de；巨大的 jùdà de
quote_en: The vast library had so many books that I could spend years reading and still not finish.
quote_zh: 那个巨大的图书馆有那么多书，我花几年时间都读不完。 Nàgè jùdà de túshūguǎn yǒu nàme duō shū, wǒ huā jǐ nián shíjiān dōu dú bù wán.
ex_en: You have a vast ocean of potential inside you—explore it, and you'll discover talents you never knew.
ex_zh: 你的内心蕴藏着一片广阔的潜力之海——去探索它，你会发现从未了解的天赋。 Nǐ de nèixīn yùncángzhe yī piàn guǎngkuò de qiánlì zhī hǎi——qù tànsuǒ tā, nǐ huì fāxiàn cóngwèi liǎojiě de tiānfù.

def_en: Related to seeing or sight
def_zh: 视觉的 shìjué de；看得见的 kàn dé jiàn de
quote_en: The visual instructions with pictures made it much easier to build the birdhouse.
quote_zh: 配有图片的视觉说明让搭建鸟屋变得容易多了。 Pèi yǒu túpiàn de shìjué shuōmíng ràng dājiàn niǎowū biàn dé róngyì duōle.
ex_en: Create a visual of your dreams—a drawing, a collage, a list—and let it remind you where you're going.
ex_zh: 为你的梦想创造一个视觉呈现——一幅画、一张拼贴画、一份清单——让它提醒你前进的方向。 Wèi nǐ de mèngxiǎng chuàngzào yī gè shìjué chéngxiàn——yī fú huà, yī zhāng pīntiēhuà, yī fèn qīngdān——ràng tā tíxǐng nǐ qiánjìn de fāngxiàng.
